sadbhir ācaritatvāt tu vr̥ttam etad agarhitam
avyaktaprabhavāny āhur avyaktanidhanāni ca
hetumac chakyam ākhyātum etāvaj jñānacakṣuṣā
kāryair avyāhatamatir vairāgyāt prakr̥tau sthitaḥ
janmato garbhavāsaṁ tu śukraśoṇitasaṁbhavam
dr̥śyante tāni tāny eva tathā brahmāharātriṣu
nānyad āsīd r̥te jīvam āsedur na tu saṁhitam
brāhmaṇā vedatattvajñās tattvārthagatiniścayāḥ
tathā rajastamaḥkarmāṇy utsr̥jya prāpnuyāt sukham
tathaivātmā śarīrastho yogenaivātra dr̥śyate
sarva ete mahātmāno gacchanti paramāṁ gatim
yadvat kāntāram ātiṣṭhan nautsukyaṁ samanuvrajet
tvam apy etan mahābhāga yathoktaṁ brahmaṇo vacaḥ
sa tayor apavargajño vītarāgo vimucyate
jñānahīnas tathā loke tasmāj jñānavido ’dhikāḥ
manasas tu pralīnatvāt tat tad āhur nidarśanam
sa tu dehād yathā dehaṁ tyaktvānyaṁ pratipadyate
śukraṁ nirmathyate tadvad dehasaṁkalpajaiḥ khajaiḥ
buddhyā ca vyavasāyena brahmacaryam akalmaṣam
trailokyaṁ tapasā vyāptam antarbhūtena bhāsvatā
netrayoḥ pratipadyante vahantyas taijasaṁ guṇam
gāndharvaṁ nārado vedaṁ bharadvājo dhanurgraham
sattvaṁ devaguṇaṁ vidyād itarāv āsurau guṇau
samyag ācara śuddhātmaṁs tataḥ siddhim avāpsyasi
sūcyā sūtraṁ yathā vastre saṁsārayati vāyakaḥ
sarveṣām eva bhūtānāṁ puruṣaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate
abhyasyanti paraṁ devaṁ vidyutsaṁśabditākṣaram
viviktacārī laghvāśī tapasvī niyatendriyaḥ
trailokyaṁ seśvaraṁ sarvam ahaṁkāre pratiṣṭhitam
iyaṁ sā buddhir anyeyaṁ yayā yāti parāṁ gatim
nigr̥hītendriyasyāsya kurvāṇasya mano vaśe
hetuḥ sa evānādāne śuddhadharmānupālane
dehakarma nudan prāṇān antakāle vimucyate
tadvat saṁsārakāntāram ātiṣṭhañ śramatatparaḥ
trailokyaprakr̥tir dehī tapasā taṁ maheśvaram
śr̥ṇu śiṣya mahāprājña brahmaguhyam idaṁ param
amr̥taṁ tad avāpnoti yat tad akṣaram avyayam
yathā dīpaḥ prakāśātmā hrasvo vā yadi vā mahān
jñātaiś ca kāraṇair dehī na dehaṁ punar arhati
uṣṇīṣavān yathā vastrais tribhir bhavati saṁvr̥taḥ
etān sattvaguṇān vidyād imān rājasatāmasān
dehaṁ tu paramaṁ vidyād vimuktam aparigraham
rajastamoghnaṁ yat karma tapasas tat svalakṣaṇam
niḥsaṁdigdham anīho vai muktaḥ sarvaparigrahaiḥ
parīkṣya saṁcared vidvān yathāvac chāstracakṣuṣā
krodhalobhau bhayaṁ darpa eteṣāṁ sādhanāc chuciḥ
kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṁ cakraṁ snigdhākṣaṁ vartate dhruvam
yena tantramayaṁ tantraṁ vr̥ttiḥ syāt tat tad ācaret
īdr̥g alpaṁ ca vaktavyam avikṣiptena cetasā
kālacakram anādyantaṁ bhāvābhāvasvalakṣaṇam
abhyāsāt sa tathā yukto na gacchet prakr̥tiṁ punaḥ
rajastamobhyāṁ nirmuktaṁ sattvaṁ nirmalatām iyāt
tataḥ paśyaty asaṁbaddhān vātapittakaphottarān
dehāntaṁ kaś cid anvāste bhāvitātmā nirāśrayaḥ
taruṇādhigataṁ jñānaṁ jarādurbalatāṁ gatam
manasy antarhitaṁ sarvaṁ veda sottamapūruṣaḥ
prāpya tat paramaṁ sthānaṁ modante ’kṣaram avyayam
etāvad etad vijñānam etad asti ca nāsti ca
paraṁ tat sarvabhūtebhyas tena yānti parāṁ gatim
saṁvr̥to ’yaṁ tathā dehī sattvarājasatāmasaiḥ
tadvad bhūteṣv ahaṁkāraṁ vidyād bhūtapravartakam
vadanti puruṣavyāghraṁ keśavaṁ puruṣarṣabham
atraivāvasthitaṁ sarvaṁ trailokyaṁ sacarācaram
sadbhir ācaritatvāt tu vr̥ttam etad agarhitam
nāvagacchanty avijñānād ātmajaṁ pārthivaṁ guṇam
ekas tad veda bhagavān dhātā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaiḥ śrāvyo rājanyaḥ kṣatriyais tathā
sudurgam iva panthānam atītya guṇabandhanam
svasaṁjñān asvajāṁs tadvat sutasaṁjñān kr̥mīṁs tyajet
tathā vārtāṁ samīkṣeta kr̥talakṣaṇasaṁmitām
brahmabhūtā virajasas tato yānti parāṁ gatim
pravr̥ttiḥ punarāvr̥ttir nivr̥ttiḥ paramā gatiḥ
vāsudevaḥ sarvam idaṁ viśvasya brahmaṇo mukham
vyānodānau samānaś ca pañcadhā dehayāpanā
hetuyuktam ataḥ sarvaṁ jagat saṁparivartate
viṣayāḥ pañca caikaṁ ca vikāre ṣoḍaśaṁ manaḥ
tad evam etau vijñeyāv avyaktapuruṣāv ubhau
ete bhāvā jagat sarvaṁ vahanti sacarācaram
atrāpy upekṣāṁ kurvīta jñātvā karmaphalaṁ jagat
tatas tam upavartante guṇā rājasatāmasāḥ
vijñānābhiniveśāt tu jāgaraty aniśaṁ sadā
sattvasya rajasaś caiva tamasaś ca nibodha tān
hiṁsāvihārābhiratas tandrīnidrāsamanvitaḥ
tat sarvaṁ dehināṁ bījaṁ sarvam ātmavataḥ samam
yatheha niyataṁ kālo darśayaty ārtavān guṇān
mānavā jñānasaṁmohāt tataḥ kāmaṁ prayānti vai
vyaktaṁ mr̥tyumukhaṁ vidyād avyaktam amr̥taṁ padam
jyotiṣmad virajo divyam atra siddhaṁ mahātmanām
prakr̥tyā kṣetrabhūtās tā narāḥ kṣetrajñalakṣaṇāḥ
saṁdeham etam utpannam acchinad bhagavān r̥ṣiḥ
tasmāt samāhitaṁ buddhyā mano bhūteṣu dhārayet
kāryakāraṇasaṁyoge sa hetur upapāditaḥ
jñānendriyāṇy ataḥ pañca pañca karmendriyāṇy api
sattvaṁ rajas tamaś ceti devāsuraguṇān viduḥ
indriyāṇāṁ rajasy eva prabhavapralayāv ubhau
ye vidur bhāvitātmānas te yānti paramāṁ gatim
ity uktavantaṁ te viprās tadā lokapitāmaham
ramaty ayaṁ yathā svapne manasā dehavān iva
pramoho harṣajaḥ prītir asaṁdeho dhr̥tiḥ smr̥tiḥ
maharṣir bhagavān atrir veda tac chukrasaṁbhavam
vaimanasyaṁ ca viṣaye yānty asya karaṇāni ca
yat tad akṣaram avyaktam amr̥taṁ brahma śāśvatam
śabdarāgāc chrotram asya jāyate bhāvitātmanaḥ
daśa vidyād dhamanyo ’tra pañcendriyaguṇāvahāḥ
śrotraṁ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇaṁ pañcendriyāṇy api
devarṣicaritaṁ gārgyaḥ kr̥ṣṇātreyaś cikitsitam
karmaṇā kālayuktena saṁsāraparivartakam
tasmān manovākśarīrair ācared dhairyam ātmanaḥ
sarvanītyā sarvagataṁ manohetu salakṣaṇam
śāntim icchann adīnātmā saṁyacched indriyāṇi ca
niṣkalmaṣaṁ brahmacaryam icchatā carituṁ sadā
hetuyuktaḥ sadotsargo bhūtānāṁ pralayas tathā
tasya māyāvidagdhāṅgā jñānabhraṣṭā nirāśiṣaḥ
krodhaharṣau viṣādaś ca jāyante hi parasparam
dvijāgryo jāyate vidvān kanyasīṁ vr̥ttim āsthitaḥ
tathāpakvakaṣāyākhyaṁ vijñānaṁ na prakāśate
dhānyāni phalamūlāni mr̥dvikārāḥ sahāmbhasā
rajasā sādhyate mohas tamasā ca nararṣabha
trailokyaṁ sarvabhūteṣu cakravat parivartate
ajaraḥ so ’maraś caiva vyaktāvyaktopadeśavān
yenaitad vartate cakram anādinidhanaṁ mahat
jāyate tad ahaṁkārād rāgayuktena cetasā
jñānayuktena manasā saṁtatena vicakṣaṇaḥ
rasajñāne tu jihveyaṁ vyāhr̥te vāk tathaiva ca
tāṁ gatiṁ paramām eti nivr̥ttiparamo muniḥ
tadvad dehagataṁ vidyād ātmānaṁ dehabandhanam
sparśanebhyas tathā vāyuḥ prāṇāpānavyapāśrayaḥ
vayotīto jarāmr̥tyū jitvā brahma sanātanam
tābhiḥ saṁsaktamanaso brahmavat saṁprakāśate
sparśaṁ vāyuguṇaṁ vidyāt sarvabhūteṣu sarvadā
sargapralayakartāram avyaktaṁ brahma śāśvatam
saṁyogalakṣaṇotpattiḥ karmajā gr̥hyate yayā
abhidravaty ayaskāntam ayo niścetanāv ubhau
snigdhatvāt tilavat sarvaṁ cakre ’smin pīḍyate jagat
pralīnair indriyair dehī vartate dehavān iva
sāmānyam etad ubhayor evaṁ hy anyad viśeṣaṇam
prakr̥tyā sargadharmiṇyā tathā trividhasattvayā
tasmāc chubhāni karmāṇi kuryād vāgbuddhikarmabhiḥ
teṣāṁ vijñānaniṣṭhānām anyat tattvaṁ na rocate
āhāraṁ niyataṁ caiva deśe kāle ca sāttvikam
tad bījaṁ dehinām āhus tad bījaṁ jīvasaṁjñitam
madhye ca hr̥dayasyaikā sirā tv atra manovahā
sattvena rajasā caiva tamasā caiva mohitāḥ
hetvāgamasadācārair yad uktaṁ tad upāsyate
karaṇaiḥ karmanirvr̥ttaiḥ kartā yad yad viceṣṭate
kāryāṇāṁ tūpakaraṇe kālo bhavati hetumān
tadvad avyaktajā bhāvāḥ kartuḥ kāraṇalakṣaṇāḥ
paramaṁ paramātmānaṁ devam akṣayam avyayam
tamasā lobhayuktāni krodhajāni ca sevate
rajas tamaś ca hitveha na tiryaggatim āpnuyāt
yadā paśyet tadā doṣān atītyāmr̥tam aśnute
tadvat saṁsārasūtraṁ hi tr̥ṣṇāsūcyā nibadhyate
yat tat sadasad avyaktaṁ svapity asmin nidarśanam
na ca taiḥ spr̥śyate bhāvo na te tena mahātmanā
tad idaṁ brahma vārṣṇeyam itihāsaṁ śr̥ṇuṣva me
prayojanam atas tv atra mārgam icchanti saṁstutam
dr̥ṣṭvemaṁ saṁtataṁ lokaṁ ghaṭen mokṣāya buddhimān
vāṅmanoniyamaḥ sāmyaṁ mānasaṁ tapa ucyate
jihvayā rasanaṁ yac ca tad eva parivarjitam
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṁ tad adhyātmaguṇaṁ viduḥ
atropāyaṁ pravakṣyāmi yathāvac chāstracakṣuṣā
vyaktāvyakte ca yat tattvaṁ saṁprāptaṁ paramarṣiṇā
atha vā mantravad brūyur māṁsādānāṁ yajuṣkr̥tam
agrāhyau puruṣāv etāv aliṅgatvād asaṁhitau
tasmāc catuṣṭayaṁ vedyam etair hetubhir ācitam
tasmād ātmavatā varjyaṁ rajaś ca tama eva ca
avāgyogaprayogeṇa manojñaṁ saṁpravartate
śabdaḥ sparśo ’tha rūpaṁ ca raso gandhas tathaiva ca
saṁpravr̥ttam udīrṇaṁ ca nigr̥hṇīyād dvijo manaḥ
vyāpakaṁ sarvabhūteṣu vartate ’pratighaṁ manaḥ
rājarṣayaḥ purāṇāś ca paramaṁ duḥkhabheṣajam
rajas tamasi paryastaṁ sattvaṁ tamasi saṁsthitam
samyagvr̥ttir brahmalokaṁ prāpnuyān madhyamaḥ surān
vikāraṁ prakr̥tiṁ caiva puruṣaṁ ca sanātanam
avyaktakarmajā buddhir ahaṁkāraṁ prasūyate
hetuyuktāḥ prakr̥tayo vikārāś ca parasparam
vidhijñebhyo dvijātibhyo grāhyam annaṁ viśiṣyate
tasmāt tad avighātāya karma kuryād akalmaṣam
kuṇapāmedhyasaṁyuktaṁ yadvad acchidrabandhanam
avyaktanābhaṁ vyaktāraṁ vikāraparimaṇḍalam
adhyātmaṁ sarvabhūtānām āgamānāṁ ca yad vasu
virāgā dagdhadoṣās te nāpnuyur dehasaṁbhavam
tyāgāt tebhyo nirodhaḥ syān nirodhajño vimucyate
atha vā manasaḥ saṅgaṁ paśyed bhūtānukampayā
rājasaṁ tāmasaṁ caiva śuddhātmākarmasaṁbhavam
tasmāt tanmātram ādadyād yāvad atra prayojanam
duḥkhaṁ vidyād upādānād abhimānāc ca vardhate
rajasā dharmayuktāni kāryāṇy api samāpnuyāt
vāgdehamanasāṁ śaucaṁ kṣamā satyaṁ dhr̥tiḥ smr̥tiḥ
kāryair avyāhatamatir vairāgyāt prakr̥tau sthitaḥ
tadvat somaguṇā jihvā gandhas tu pr̥thivīguṇaḥ
na bhūḥ khaṁ dyaur na bhūtāni narṣayo na surāsurāḥ
ye tv asaktā mahātmānas te yānti paramāṁ gatim
paripakvabuddhiḥ kālena ādatte mānasaṁ balam
ā dehād apramādāc ca dehāntād vipramucyate
bījāny agnyupadagdhāni na rohanti yathā punaḥ
rūparāgāt tathā cakṣur ghrāṇaṁ gandhacikīrṣayā
svadehajān asvasaṁjñān yadvad aṅgāt kr̥mīṁs tyajet
bhāvena yānti śuddhā ye jñānatr̥ptā nirāśiṣaḥ
majjāṁ caiva sirājālais tarpayanti rasā nr̥ṇām
nāgāsuramanuṣyāṁś ca sr̥jate paramo ’vyayaḥ
kr̥tavanto mahātmānas tato lokān avāpnuvan
ahiṁsā satyavacanaṁ sarvabhūteṣu cārjavam
śriyaṁ divyām abhiprepsur brahma vāṅmanasā śuciḥ
śukram asparśajaṁ dehāt sr̥janty asya manovahā
payasy antarhitaṁ sarpir yadvan nirmathyate khajaiḥ
yadvan manorathaiśvaryaṁ svapne tadvan manogatam
niṣpanno dr̥śyate vyaktam avyaktāt saṁbhavas tathā
netrahīno yathā hy ekaḥ kr̥cchrāṇi labhate ’dhvani
ākāśaṁ cāpy ahaṁkārād vāyur ākāśasaṁbhavaḥ
doṣair mūlād avacchinnair viśuddhātmā vimucyate
pratilomāṁ diśaṁ buddhvā saṁsāram abudhās tathā
śukrato rasataś caiva snehāj jāyanti jantavaḥ
jñānābhyāsāj jāgarato jijñāsārtham anantaram
tathaitad antaraṁ vidyāt kṣetrakṣetrajñayor budhaḥ
atrāha ko nv ayaṁ bhāvaḥ svapne viṣayavān iva
kṣetrajñam evānuyāti pāṁsur vāterito yathā
kīrtyate śabdasaṁjñābhiḥ ko ’ham eṣo ’py asāv iti
karma tat kurute tarṣād ahaṁkāraparigraham
nivr̥ttilakṣaṇaṁ dharmam avyaktaṁ brahma śāśvatam
vyāpakaḥ saguṇaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sarvabhūtaguṇāśrayaḥ
caturvidhāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
vivakṣatā vā sadvākyaṁ dharmaṁ sūkṣmam avekṣatā
mānadarpād ahaṁkāram ahaṁkārāt tataḥ kriyāḥ
tathākr̥tātmā sahajair doṣair naśyati rājasaiḥ
taṁ viśeṣam avekṣeta viśeṣeṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ
lipseta manasā yaś ca saṁkalpād aiśvaraṁ guṇam
ity uktās te tu munayo brahmaṇā guruṇā tathā
pāpmānaṁ nirdahed evam antarbhūtaṁ rajomayam
duranteṣv indriyārtheṣu saktāḥ sīdanti jantavaḥ
vināśayati saṁbhūtam ayasmayamayo yathā
lebhire tapasā pūrvam anujñātāḥ svayaṁbhuvā
devatās tāḥ prakāśante hr̥ṣṭā yānti tam īśvaram
tathā rajastamaḥkarmāṇy utsr̥jya prāpnuyāt sukham
kṣāntyā dhr̥tyā ca buddhyā ca manasā tapasaiva ca
suduṣkaraṁ brahmacaryam upāyaṁ tatra me śr̥ṇu
svabhāvahetujā bhāvā yadvad anyad apīdr̥śam
te yānti paramām̐l lokān viśudhyanto yathābalam
prakr̥tiḥ sr̥jate tadvad ānantyān nāpacīyate
bhavāntaprabhavaprajñā āsate ye viparyayam
niṣpracāreṇa manasā paraṁ tad adhigacchati
yathāśvatthakaṇīkāyām antarbhūto mahādrumaḥ
pitr̥̄n devān r̥ṣīṁś caiva tathā vai yakṣadānavān
viparītam ato vidyāt kṣetrajñasya ca lakṣaṇam
svabhāvāt karmayogād vā tān upekṣeta buddhimān
purīṣamūtravikledaśoṇitaprabhavāvilam
so ’tra vedayate vedyaṁ sa śr̥ṇoti sa paśyati
avyaktapuruṣābhyāṁ tu yat syād anyan mahattaram
tat tad utpadyate jñānaṁ lokayātrāvidhānajam
doṣāṇām evamādīnāṁ parīkṣya gurulāghavam
tat parīkṣyānuvarteta yat pravr̥ttyanuvartakam
nāśuddham ācaret tasmād abhīpsan dehayāpanam
yo yathāvad vijānāti sa vitr̥ṣṇo vimucyate
tathā taṁ saṁpravakṣyāmi bhūtagrāmaṁ svakarmajam
mano buddhyā nigr̥hṇīyād viṣayān manasātmanaḥ
ātmaprabhāvāt taṁ vidyāt sarvā hy ātmani devatāḥ
pratāpas tapaso jñānaṁ loke saṁśabditaṁ tapaḥ
tasmād etā viśeṣeṇa naro ’tīyur vipaścitaḥ
jñānendriyāṇīndriyārthān nopasarpanty atarṣulam
tr̥ṣṇābaddhaṁ jagat sarvaṁ cakravat parivartate
śrotraṁ śabdaguṇaṁ caiva cakṣur agner guṇas tathā
svapnayoge yathaivātmā pañcendriyasamāgataḥ
avyaktaprabhavāny āhur avyaktanidhanāni ca
karmaṇo vivaraṁ kurvan na lokān āpnuyāc chubhān
etad devāsurair guptaṁ tad āhur jñānalakṣaṇam
yaś cainaṁ paramaṁ dharmaṁ sarvabhūtasukhāvaham
lohayuktaṁ yathā hema vipakvaṁ na virājate
kaṣāyavarjitaṁ jñānaṁ yeṣām utpadyate ’calam
agnir dārugato yadvad bhinne dārau na dr̥śyate
guṇānāṁ sāmyam āgamya manasaiva manovaham
tasmāt samyak parīkṣeta doṣān ajñānasaṁbhavān
mahābhūtānīndriyāṇi guṇāḥ sattvaṁ rajas tamaḥ
karmaṇā vyāpyate pūrvaṁ karmaṇā copapadyate
sparśarūparasādyeṣu saṅgaṁ gacchanti bāliśāḥ
prasannair indriyair yad yat saṁkalpayati mānasam
evam etāḥ sirānadyo rasodā dehasāgaram
tathā mūlaphalaṁ bhaikṣaṁ paryāyeṇopayojayet
kam abhiṣṭuvate cāyaṁ kaṁ vā krośati kiṁ vadet
tr̥ṣṇābhibhūtas tair baddhas tān evābhipariplavan
viṣṇum avyaktasaṁsthānaṁ viśante devasattamam
nāpadhyāyen na spr̥hayen nābaddhaṁ cintayed asat
śramād āhāram ādadyād asvādv api hi yāpanam
sarvabhūtaviśiṣṭās te sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ
vedavid veda bhagavān vedāṅgāni br̥haspatiḥ
bhagavantam ajaṁ divyaṁ viṣṇum avyaktasaṁjñitam
puruṣebhyo dvijān āhur dvijebhyo mantravādinaḥ
cakravat parivartante hy ajñānāj jantavo bhr̥śam
liṅgasaṁyogahīnaṁ yac charīrasparśavarjitam
bhārgavo nītiśāstraṁ ca jagāda jagato hitam
dr̥śyante tāni tāny eva tathā brahmāharātriṣu
vātapittakaphān raktaṁ tvaṅmāṁsaṁ snāyum asthi ca
vimr̥śed ātmasaṁsthānām ekaikam anusaṁtatam
rajobhūtair hi karaṇaiḥ karmaṇā pratipadyate
durlabhā vedavidvāṁso vedokteṣu vyavasthitāḥ
karmagarbhair guṇair dehī garbhe tad upapadyate
satyaśaucārjavatyāgair yaśasā vikrameṇa ca
praśānto jñānavān bhikṣur nirapekṣaś caret sukham
buddhyā hy anigr̥hītena manasā karma tāmasam
sūryaś ca candramāś caiva bhāsatas tapasā divi
janmamr̥tyujarāduḥkhair vyādhibhir manasaḥ klamaiḥ
prakāśaṁ bhagavān etad r̥ṣir nārāyaṇo ’mr̥tam
anādyantāv ubhāv etāv aliṅgau cāpy ubhāv api
nyāyatantrāṇy anekāni tais tair uktāni vādibhiḥ
sa dehī vimalaḥ śrīmāñ śuddho vidyāsamanvitaḥ
jñātvātmasthaṁ hariṁ caiva nivartante na te ’vyayāḥ
rāgotpattau caret kr̥cchram ahnas triḥ praviśed apaḥ
vidyāt tu ṣoḍaśaitāni daivatāni vibhāgaśaḥ
ajñānakarma nirdiṣṭam etat kāraṇalakṣaṇam
avyaktanidhanaṁ vidyād avyaktātmātmakaṁ manaḥ
yābhiḥ sūkṣmāḥ pratāyante dhamanyo ’nyāḥ sahasraśaḥ
pravr̥ttilakṣaṇo dharmo yathāyam upapadyate
jñānātmānaṁ tathā vidyāt puruṣaṁ sarvajantuṣu
svapne ’py evaṁ yathābhyeti manaḥsaṁkalpajaṁ rajaḥ
yugānte ’ntarhitān vedān setihāsān maharṣayaḥ
śabdādīn viṣayāṁs tasmād asaṁrāgād anuplavet
yathāgamaṁ ca tat sarvaṁ buddhyā tan naiva budhyate
saṁtanvānā yathā yānti tathā dehāḥ śarīriṇām
rajasy antarhitā mūrtir indriyāṇāṁ sanātanī
yukto dhāraṇayā kaś cit sattāṁ ke cid upāsate
yad idaṁ brahmaṇo rūpaṁ brahmacaryam iti smr̥tam
pravr̥ttilakṣaṇaṁ dharmam r̥ṣir nārāyaṇo ’bravīt
indriyāṇāṁ śramāt svapnam āhuḥ sarvagataṁ budhāḥ
ye vai śukragatiṁ vidyur bhūtasaṁkarakārikām
bhāvān sarvān yathāvr̥ttān saṁvaseta yathākramam
kṣamā caivāpramādaś ca yasyaite sa sukhī bhavet
parapratyayasarge tu niyataṁ nātivartate
tat kāraṇair hi saṁyuktaṁ kāryasaṁgrahakārakam
nātyeti kāraṇaṁ kāryaṁ na kāryaṁ kāraṇaṁ tathā
saṁjātair jāyate gātraiḥ karmajair brahmaṇā vr̥taḥ
sāttviko vā yathāyogam ānantaryaphalodayaḥ
ajñānaprabhavaṁ nityam ahaṁkāraṁ parityajet
tathaiva vedaśāstrāṇi lokadharmāṁś ca śāśvatān
punaḥ saṁśayam āpannāḥ papracchur dvijasattamāḥ
arhas tvam asi kalyāṇa vārṣṇeyaṁ śr̥ṇu yat param
na sa veda paraṁ dharmaṁ yo na veda catuṣṭayam
sarvadharmeṣu dharmajñā jñāpayanti guṇān imān
dīpād anye yathā dīpāḥ pravartante sahasraśaḥ
rajasā cāpy ayaṁ dehī dehavāñ śabdavac caret
śritā virajasaṁ devaṁ yam āhuḥ paramaṁ padam
antakāle hy upāsannās tapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ
brāhmaṇā vedatattvajñās tattvārthagatiniścayāḥ
tapo hy adhiṣṭhitaṁ devais tapoghnam asurais tamaḥ
jñānendhitaṁ tato jñānam arkavat saṁprakāśate
jñānadagdhais tathā kleśair nātmā saṁbadhyate punaḥ
pravr̥ttaṁ noparundheta śanair agnim ivendhayet
evaṁ hi tapasā yuktam arkavat tamasaḥ param
navadvāraṁ puraṁ puṇyam etair bhāvaiḥ samanvitam
vāṅmanobhyāṁ śarīreṇa śuciḥ syād anahaṁkr̥taḥ
deheṣu jñānakartāram upāsīnam upāsate
sarvagātrapratāyinyas tasyā hy anugatāḥ sirāḥ
kaṇapiṇyākakulmāṣaśākayāvakasaktavaḥ
pādau pāyur upasthaś ca hastau vāk karmaṇām api
saṁmohakaṁ tamo vidyāt kr̥ṣṇam ajñānasaṁbhavam
tribījam indradaivatyaṁ tasmād indriyam ucyate
antarikṣād anyataraṁ dhāraṇāsaktamānasam
tān eva ca yathā dasyūn kṣiptvā gacchec chivāṁ diśam
tāṁs tān upāsate dharmān dharmakāmā yathāgamam
tathaitad upapannārthaṁ varṇayanti maharṣayaḥ
kriyābhiḥ snehasaṁbandhaḥ snehāc chokam anantaram
antakāle vayotkarṣāc chanaiḥ kuryād anāturaḥ
yaś cādharmaṁ caren mohāt kāmalobhāv anu plavan
etaiś cāpagataiḥ sarvair brahmabhūyāya kalpate
satyāṁ vācam ahiṁsrāṁ ca vaded anapavādinīm
bhūtānām anukampārthaṁ jagāda jagato hitam
brahmacaryam ahiṁsā ca śārīraṁ tapa ucyate
kāraṇaṁ tasya deho ’yaṁ sa kartā sarvakarmaṇām
sukhaduḥkhasamārambhāj janmājanmakr̥takṣaṇāḥ
duḥkhān niḥsaraṇaṁ veda sa tattvajñaḥ sukhī bhavet
sarajasko ’rajaskaś ca sa vai vāyur yathā bhavet
nārāyaṇād r̥ṣigaṇās tathā mukhyāḥ surāsurāḥ
nānyad āsīd r̥te jīvam āsedur na tu saṁhitam
dhr̥tyā dehān dhārayanto buddhisaṁkṣiptamānasāḥ
yathartuṣv r̥tuliṅgāni nānārūpāṇi paryaye
evaṁ yuktena manasā jñānaṁ tad upapadyate
svapne hi rajasā dehī tamasā cābhibhūyate
kāmakrodhau pramādaś ca lobhamohau bhayaṁ klamaḥ
puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṁ bhāvaṁ prakr̥tiḥ sūyate sadā
janmato garbhavāsaṁ tu śukraśoṇitasaṁbhavam
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṁ tasmād budhyeta buddhimān
vyāpya śete mahān ātmā tasmāt puruṣa ucyate
tat tat svapne ’py uparate manodr̥ṣṭir nirīkṣate
tarpayanti yathākālam āpagā iva sāgaram
pārthivo ’yaṁ tathā deho mr̥dvikārair vilipyate
yathāsaṁjño hy ayaṁ samyag antakāle na muhyati
śarīravān upādatte mohāt sarvaparigrahān
rajastamobhavair bhāvais tad apy āhur duranvayam
karmaṇā bījabhūtena codyate yad yad indriyam
pravr̥ttilakṣaṇaṁ dharmaṁ prajāpatir athābravīt
tilapīḍair ivākramya bhogair ajñānasaṁbhavaiḥ
bisatantur yathaivāyam antaḥsthaḥ sarvato bise
tat tac chaṁsanti bhūtāni mano yad bhāvitaṁ yathā
tr̥ṣṇātantur anādyantas tathā dehagataḥ sadā
karmaṇā nīyate ’nyatra svakr̥tena balīyasā
saṁsāratantravāhinyas tatra budhyeta yoṣitaḥ
mūlaprakr̥tayo ’ṣṭau tā jagad etāsv avasthitam
deham utsr̥jya vai yāti tathaivātropalabhyate
dhr̥timān ātmavān buddhiṁ nigr̥hṇīyād asaṁśayam
prītiduḥkhanibaddhāṁś ca samastāṁs trīn atho guṇān
āhāraniyamenāsya pāpmā naśyati rājasaḥ
dharmyaṁ panthānam ākramya sānubandho vinaśyati
kāmāt krodham avāpyātha lobhamohau ca mānavāḥ
kr̥tyā hy etā ghorarūpā mohayanty avicakṣaṇān
sarajastāmasair bhāvaiś cyuto hetubalānvitaḥ
pralaye prakr̥tiṁ prāpya yugādau sr̥jate prabhuḥ
puruṣaṁ sanātanaṁ viṣṇuṁ yat tad vedavido viduḥ
sthānebhyo dhvaṁsamānāś ca sūkṣmatvāt tān upāsate
atha yad yad yadā bhāvi kālayogād yugādiṣu
mr̥nmayaṁ śaraṇaṁ yadvan mr̥daiva parilipyate
vijñānānugataṁ jñānam ajñānād apakr̥ṣyate
śrotreṇa śravaṇaṁ caiva cakṣuṣā caiva darśanam
saṁsārāṇām asaṁkhyānāṁ kāmātmā tad avāpnuyāt
madhu tailaṁ payaḥ sarpir māṁsāni lavaṇaṁ guḍaḥ
kāmakrodhādibhir bhāvair yukto rājasatāmasaiḥ
prakīrṇameṣabhāro hi yadvad dhāryeta dasyubhiḥ
indriyair vividhair yuktaṁ sarvaṁ vyastaṁ manas tathā
śukraṁ saṁkalpajaṁ nr̥̄ṇāṁ sarvagātrair vimuñcati
martyalokād vimucyante vidyāsaṁyuktamānasāḥ
anyonyam abhivartante puruṣādhiṣṭhitāḥ sadā
jñānatattvaparo nityaṁ śubhāśubhanidarśakaḥ
yoṣitāṁ na kathāḥ śrāvyā na nirīkṣyā nirambarāḥ
dehāntaram ivāpannaś caraty apagatasmr̥tiḥ
manasy antarhitaṁ dvāraṁ deham āsthāya mānasam
guṇānām api yad yat tat karma jānāty upasthitam
manaḥ sattvaguṇaṁ prāhuḥ sattvam avyaktajaṁ tathā
kadā cid darśanād āsāṁ durbalān āviśed rajaḥ
atha vā na pravarteta yogatantrair upakramet
prakr̥teś ca vikārāṇāṁ draṣṭāram aguṇānvitam
viṣādaśokāv aratir mānadarpāv anāryatā
vijñeyaṁ vyāpakaṁ cittaṁ teṣu sarvagataṁ manaḥ
sūkṣmaṁ viśeṣaṇaṁ teṣām avekṣec chāstracakṣuṣā
tad vijñānāc caran prājñaḥ prāpnuyāt paramāṁ gatim
pr̥thaktvāt saṁprayogāc ca nāsūyur veda śāśvatam
pratyāhāreṇa vā śakyam avyaktaṁ brahma veditum
bhavitā manaso jñānaṁ mana eva pratāyate
yat kr̥taṁ prāk śubhaṁ karma pāpaṁ vā tad upāśnute
yātrārtham adyād āhāraṁ vyādhito bheṣajaṁ yathā
atrocyate yathā hy etad veda yogeśvaro hariḥ
satyaṁ dānam atho yajñas titikṣā dama ārjavam
anādyaṁ yat paraṁ brahma na devā narṣayo viduḥ
arthayuktāni cātyarthaṁ kāmān sarvāṁś ca sevate
nidrā sarvātmanā tyājyā svapnadoṣān avekṣatā
sa duḥkhaṁ prāpya loke ’smin narakāyopapadyate
kāryavyāsaktamanasaḥ saṁkalpo jāgrato hy api
na tv eṣām arthasāmānyam antareṇa guṇān imān
vākprabuddho hi saṁrāgād virāgād vyāhared yadi
śārīrair niyamair ugraiś caren niṣkalmaṣaṁ tapaḥ
sattvasthaḥ sāttvikān bhāvāñ śuddhān paśyati saṁśritaḥ
vāyos tejas tataś cāpas tv adbhyo hi vasudhodgatā
nadīṣv āpo yathā yuktā yathā sūrye marīcayaḥ
hetumac chakyam ākhyātum etāvaj jñānacakṣuṣā
kalkāpetām aparuṣām anr̥śaṁsām apaiśunām
jñānadagdhaparikleśaḥ prayogaratir ātmavān
magnaḥ svapne ca manasā trir japed aghamarṣaṇam
ubhau nityau sūkṣmatarau mahadbhyaś ca mahattarau
māhātmyaṁ devadevasya viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ
brahma tatparamaṁ vedyam amr̥taṁ jyotir akṣaram
tasmāt tarṣātmakād rāgād bījāj jāyanti jantavaḥ
pañcabhūtātmake dehe sattvarājasatāmase
acetanāś cetayituḥ kāraṇād abhisaṁhitāḥ
jñānādhiṣṭhānam ajñānaṁ buddhyahaṁkāralakṣaṇam
jñānādhiṣṭhānam ajñānaṁ trīm̐l lokān adhitiṣṭhati
duḥkhādyantair duḥkhamadhyair naraḥ śārīramānasaiḥ
vijñānābhiniveśāt tu jāgaraty aniśaṁ sadā
sparśarūparasādyeṣu saṅgaṁ gacchanti bāliśāḥ
brahmabhūtā virajasas tato yānti parāṁ gatim
samyag ācara śuddhātmaṁs tataḥ siddhim avāpsyasi
ā dehād apramādāc ca dehāntād vipramucyate
vāyos tejas tataś cāpas tv adbhyo hi vasudhodgatā
tr̥ṣṇābhibhūtas tair baddhas tān evābhipariplavan
caturvidhāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
kāraṇaṁ tasya deho ’yaṁ sa kartā sarvakarmaṇām
saṁyogalakṣaṇotpattiḥ karmajā gr̥hyate yayā
tad idaṁ brahma vārṣṇeyam itihāsaṁ śr̥ṇuṣva me
indriyair vividhair yuktaṁ sarvaṁ vyastaṁ manas tathā
kuṇapāmedhyasaṁyuktaṁ yadvad acchidrabandhanam
kalkāpetām aparuṣām anr̥śaṁsām apaiśunām
pramoho harṣajaḥ prītir asaṁdeho dhr̥tiḥ smr̥tiḥ
yaś cādharmaṁ caren mohāt kāmalobhāv anu plavan
brahma tatparamaṁ vedyam amr̥taṁ jyotir akṣaram
māhātmyaṁ devadevasya viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ
nadīṣv āpo yathā yuktā yathā sūrye marīcayaḥ
bhūtānām anukampārthaṁ jagāda jagato hitam
tāṁ gatiṁ paramām eti nivr̥ttiparamo muniḥ
ajaraḥ so ’maraś caiva vyaktāvyaktopadeśavān
saṁvr̥to ’yaṁ tathā dehī sattvarājasatāmasaiḥ
ātmaprabhāvāt taṁ vidyāt sarvā hy ātmani devatāḥ
duranteṣv indriyārtheṣu saktāḥ sīdanti jantavaḥ
śrotraṁ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇaṁ pañcendriyāṇy api
jñānadagdhais tathā kleśair nātmā saṁbadhyate punaḥ
kāryavyāsaktamanasaḥ saṁkalpo jāgrato hy api
yat tad akṣaram avyaktam amr̥taṁ brahma śāśvatam
maharṣir bhagavān atrir veda tac chukrasaṁbhavam
avyaktanābhaṁ vyaktāraṁ vikāraparimaṇḍalam
ye vidur bhāvitātmānas te yānti paramāṁ gatim
bhāvena yānti śuddhā ye jñānatr̥ptā nirāśiṣaḥ
etaiś cāpagataiḥ sarvair brahmabhūyāya kalpate
na sa veda paraṁ dharmaṁ yo na veda catuṣṭayam
taruṇādhigataṁ jñānaṁ jarādurbalatāṁ gatam
manasy antarhitaṁ sarvaṁ veda sottamapūruṣaḥ
niḥsaṁdigdham anīho vai muktaḥ sarvaparigrahaiḥ
saṁsārāṇām asaṁkhyānāṁ kāmātmā tad avāpnuyāt
agnir dārugato yadvad bhinne dārau na dr̥śyate
viviktacārī laghvāśī tapasvī niyatendriyaḥ
yātrārtham adyād āhāraṁ vyādhito bheṣajaṁ yathā
hetuyuktaḥ sadotsargo bhūtānāṁ pralayas tathā
ity uktavantaṁ te viprās tadā lokapitāmaham
tadvat saṁsārakāntāram ātiṣṭhañ śramatatparaḥ
rāgotpattau caret kr̥cchram ahnas triḥ praviśed apaḥ
mūlaprakr̥tayo ’ṣṭau tā jagad etāsv avasthitam
āhāraṁ niyataṁ caiva deśe kāle ca sāttvikam
dr̥śyante tāni tāny eva tathā brahmāharātriṣu
tat tac chaṁsanti bhūtāni mano yad bhāvitaṁ yathā
tathā taṁ saṁpravakṣyāmi bhūtagrāmaṁ svakarmajam
atrāha ko nv ayaṁ bhāvaḥ svapne viṣayavān iva
tadvad dehagataṁ vidyād ātmānaṁ dehabandhanam
te yānti paramām̐l lokān viśudhyanto yathābalam
mano buddhyā nigr̥hṇīyād viṣayān manasātmanaḥ
vyāpakaḥ saguṇaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sarvabhūtaguṇāśrayaḥ
guṇānāṁ sāmyam āgamya manasaiva manovaham
ye tv asaktā mahātmānas te yānti paramāṁ gatim
karmaṇā nīyate ’nyatra svakr̥tena balīyasā
pañcabhūtātmake dehe sattvarājasatāmase
tat parīkṣyānuvarteta yat pravr̥ttyanuvartakam
viṣṇum avyaktasaṁsthānaṁ viśante devasattamam
doṣāṇām evamādīnāṁ parīkṣya gurulāghavam
yābhiḥ sūkṣmāḥ pratāyante dhamanyo ’nyāḥ sahasraśaḥ
satyaśaucārjavatyāgair yaśasā vikrameṇa ca
payasy antarhitaṁ sarpir yadvan nirmathyate khajaiḥ
avāgyogaprayogeṇa manojñaṁ saṁpravartate
tathaivātmā śarīrastho yogenaivātra dr̥śyate
śabdaḥ sparśo ’tha rūpaṁ ca raso gandhas tathaiva ca
sattvaṁ rajas tamaś ceti devāsuraguṇān viduḥ
nārāyaṇād r̥ṣigaṇās tathā mukhyāḥ surāsurāḥ
kadā cid darśanād āsāṁ durbalān āviśed rajaḥ
ramaty ayaṁ yathā svapne manasā dehavān iva
śriyaṁ divyām abhiprepsur brahma vāṅmanasā śuciḥ
sarvagātrapratāyinyas tasyā hy anugatāḥ sirāḥ
kr̥tavanto mahātmānas tato lokān avāpnuvan
janmamr̥tyujarāduḥkhair vyādhibhir manasaḥ klamaiḥ
prayojanam atas tv atra mārgam icchanti saṁstutam
tasya māyāvidagdhāṅgā jñānabhraṣṭā nirāśiṣaḥ
amr̥taṁ tad avāpnoti yat tad akṣaram avyayam
tapo hy adhiṣṭhitaṁ devais tapoghnam asurais tamaḥ
mānadarpād ahaṁkāram ahaṁkārāt tataḥ kriyāḥ
taṁ viśeṣam avekṣeta viśeṣeṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ
rajasā cāpy ayaṁ dehī dehavāñ śabdavac caret
rajasā dharmayuktāni kāryāṇy api samāpnuyāt
jñānatattvaparo nityaṁ śubhāśubhanidarśakaḥ
pratāpas tapaso jñānaṁ loke saṁśabditaṁ tapaḥ
jñātaiś ca kāraṇair dehī na dehaṁ punar arhati
janmato garbhavāsaṁ tu śukraśoṇitasaṁbhavam
pārthivo ’yaṁ tathā deho mr̥dvikārair vilipyate
tadvat saṁsārasūtraṁ hi tr̥ṣṇāsūcyā nibadhyate
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṁ tasmād budhyeta buddhimān
nāvagacchanty avijñānād ātmajaṁ pārthivaṁ guṇam
yatheha niyataṁ kālo darśayaty ārtavān guṇān
snigdhatvāt tilavat sarvaṁ cakre ’smin pīḍyate jagat
tān eva ca yathā dasyūn kṣiptvā gacchec chivāṁ diśam
antakāle vayotkarṣāc chanaiḥ kuryād anāturaḥ
manasy antarhitaṁ dvāraṁ deham āsthāya mānasam
kṣetrajñam evānuyāti pāṁsur vāterito yathā
pitr̥̄n devān r̥ṣīṁś caiva tathā vai yakṣadānavān
dīpād anye yathā dīpāḥ pravartante sahasraśaḥ
brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaiḥ śrāvyo rājanyaḥ kṣatriyais tathā
satyaṁ dānam atho yajñas titikṣā dama ārjavam
ajñānakarma nirdiṣṭam etat kāraṇalakṣaṇam
netrayoḥ pratipadyante vahantyas taijasaṁ guṇam
tarpayanti yathākālam āpagā iva sāgaram
madhye ca hr̥dayasyaikā sirā tv atra manovahā
sūkṣmaṁ viśeṣaṇaṁ teṣām avekṣec chāstracakṣuṣā
tilapīḍair ivākramya bhogair ajñānasaṁbhavaiḥ
pādau pāyur upasthaś ca hastau vāk karmaṇām api
yenaitad vartate cakram anādinidhanaṁ mahat
mahābhūtānīndriyāṇi guṇāḥ sattvaṁ rajas tamaḥ
so ’tra vedayate vedyaṁ sa śr̥ṇoti sa paśyati
rājasaṁ tāmasaṁ caiva śuddhātmākarmasaṁbhavam
jñānādhiṣṭhānam ajñānaṁ buddhyahaṁkāralakṣaṇam
hetuyuktam ataḥ sarvaṁ jagat saṁparivartate
nānyad āsīd r̥te jīvam āsedur na tu saṁhitam
sarvanītyā sarvagataṁ manohetu salakṣaṇam
sparśanebhyas tathā vāyuḥ prāṇāpānavyapāśrayaḥ
krodhalobhau bhayaṁ darpa eteṣāṁ sādhanāc chuciḥ
etāvad etad vijñānam etad asti ca nāsti ca
tasmāt samyak parīkṣeta doṣān ajñānasaṁbhavān
karmagarbhair guṇair dehī garbhe tad upapadyate
karma tat kurute tarṣād ahaṁkāraparigraham
tribījam indradaivatyaṁ tasmād indriyam ucyate
tadvad bhūteṣv ahaṁkāraṁ vidyād bhūtapravartakam
paramaṁ paramātmānaṁ devam akṣayam avyayam
teṣāṁ vijñānaniṣṭhānām anyat tattvaṁ na rocate
viparītam ato vidyāt kṣetrajñasya ca lakṣaṇam
tad evam etau vijñeyāv avyaktapuruṣāv ubhau
lipseta manasā yaś ca saṁkalpād aiśvaraṁ guṇam
avyaktanidhanaṁ vidyād avyaktātmātmakaṁ manaḥ
liṅgasaṁyogahīnaṁ yac charīrasparśavarjitam
tatas tam upavartante guṇā rājasatāmasāḥ
trailokyaprakr̥tir dehī tapasā taṁ maheśvaram
abhidravaty ayaskāntam ayo niścetanāv ubhau
arhas tvam asi kalyāṇa vārṣṇeyaṁ śr̥ṇu yat param
rūparāgāt tathā cakṣur ghrāṇaṁ gandhacikīrṣayā
guṇānām api yad yat tat karma jānāty upasthitam
jñānādhiṣṭhānam ajñānaṁ trīm̐l lokān adhitiṣṭhati
ahiṁsā satyavacanaṁ sarvabhūteṣu cārjavam
kṣāntyā dhr̥tyā ca buddhyā ca manasā tapasaiva ca
yena tantramayaṁ tantraṁ vr̥ttiḥ syāt tat tad ācaret
lohayuktaṁ yathā hema vipakvaṁ na virājate
sāmānyam etad ubhayor evaṁ hy anyad viśeṣaṇam
kaṇapiṇyākakulmāṣaśākayāvakasaktavaḥ
jñānendriyāṇīndriyārthān nopasarpanty atarṣulam
pravr̥ttilakṣaṇaṁ dharmam r̥ṣir nārāyaṇo ’bravīt
svabhāvahetujā bhāvā yadvad anyad apīdr̥śam
praśānto jñānavān bhikṣur nirapekṣaś caret sukham
jñānātmānaṁ tathā vidyāt puruṣaṁ sarvajantuṣu
brāhmaṇā vedatattvajñās tattvārthagatiniścayāḥ
kriyābhiḥ snehasaṁbandhaḥ snehāc chokam anantaram
vāgdehamanasāṁ śaucaṁ kṣamā satyaṁ dhr̥tiḥ smr̥tiḥ
karmaṇā kālayuktena saṁsāraparivartakam
śabdādīn viṣayāṁs tasmād asaṁrāgād anuplavet
jihvayā rasanaṁ yac ca tad eva parivarjitam
śrotraṁ śabdaguṇaṁ caiva cakṣur agner guṇas tathā
vyaktaṁ mr̥tyumukhaṁ vidyād avyaktam amr̥taṁ padam
ākāśaṁ cāpy ahaṁkārād vāyur ākāśasaṁbhavaḥ
kālacakram anādyantaṁ bhāvābhāvasvalakṣaṇam
prakāśaṁ bhagavān etad r̥ṣir nārāyaṇo ’mr̥tam
paripakvabuddhiḥ kālena ādatte mānasaṁ balam
jñānendhitaṁ tato jñānam arkavat saṁprakāśate
nāpadhyāyen na spr̥hayen nābaddhaṁ cintayed asat
evam etāḥ sirānadyo rasodā dehasāgaram
tadvat somaguṇā jihvā gandhas tu pr̥thivīguṇaḥ
pralaye prakr̥tiṁ prāpya yugādau sr̥jate prabhuḥ
śāntim icchann adīnātmā saṁyacched indriyāṇi ca
tathā mūlaphalaṁ bhaikṣaṁ paryāyeṇopayojayet
niṣpanno dr̥śyate vyaktam avyaktāt saṁbhavas tathā
puruṣebhyo dvijān āhur dvijebhyo mantravādinaḥ
tat tad utpadyate jñānaṁ lokayātrāvidhānajam
sarajasko ’rajaskaś ca sa vai vāyur yathā bhavet
sattvasya rajasaś caiva tamasaś ca nibodha tān
paraṁ tat sarvabhūtebhyas tena yānti parāṁ gatim
abhyāsāt sa tathā yukto na gacchet prakr̥tiṁ punaḥ
svasaṁjñān asvajāṁs tadvat sutasaṁjñān kr̥mīṁs tyajet
atropāyaṁ pravakṣyāmi yathāvac chāstracakṣuṣā
duḥkhān niḥsaraṇaṁ veda sa tattvajñaḥ sukhī bhavet
vadanti puruṣavyāghraṁ keśavaṁ puruṣarṣabham
rajas tamaś ca hitveha na tiryaggatim āpnuyāt
śabdarāgāc chrotram asya jāyate bhāvitātmanaḥ
karmaṇo vivaraṁ kurvan na lokān āpnuyāc chubhān
manaḥ sattvaguṇaṁ prāhuḥ sattvam avyaktajaṁ tathā
vāsudevaḥ sarvam idaṁ viśvasya brahmaṇo mukham
tataḥ paśyaty asaṁbaddhān vātapittakaphottarān
tvam apy etan mahābhāga yathoktaṁ brahmaṇo vacaḥ
jñātvātmasthaṁ hariṁ caiva nivartante na te ’vyayāḥ
brahmacaryam ahiṁsā ca śārīraṁ tapa ucyate
dehāntaram ivāpannaś caraty apagatasmr̥tiḥ
bhārgavo nītiśāstraṁ ca jagāda jagato hitam
saṁpravr̥ttam udīrṇaṁ ca nigr̥hṇīyād dvijo manaḥ
viṣayāḥ pañca caikaṁ ca vikāre ṣoḍaśaṁ manaḥ
pratilomāṁ diśaṁ buddhvā saṁsāram abudhās tathā
pralīnair indriyair dehī vartate dehavān iva
rājarṣayaḥ purāṇāś ca paramaṁ duḥkhabheṣajam
hetvāgamasadācārair yad uktaṁ tad upāsyate
sparśaṁ vāyuguṇaṁ vidyāt sarvabhūteṣu sarvadā
indriyāṇāṁ śramāt svapnam āhuḥ sarvagataṁ budhāḥ
jñānayuktena manasā saṁtatena vicakṣaṇaḥ
punaḥ saṁśayam āpannāḥ papracchur dvijasattamāḥ
sarva ete mahātmāno gacchanti paramāṁ gatim
sthānebhyo dhvaṁsamānāś ca sūkṣmatvāt tān upāsate
bījāny agnyupadagdhāni na rohanti yathā punaḥ
sarvadharmeṣu dharmajñā jñāpayanti guṇān imān
sargapralayakartāram avyaktaṁ brahma śāśvatam
jñānābhyāsāj jāgarato jijñāsārtham anantaram
uṣṇīṣavān yathā vastrais tribhir bhavati saṁvr̥taḥ
rajasā sādhyate mohas tamasā ca nararṣabha
yathāśvatthakaṇīkāyām antarbhūto mahādrumaḥ
prakīrṇameṣabhāro hi yadvad dhāryeta dasyubhiḥ
yathā dīpaḥ prakāśātmā hrasvo vā yadi vā mahān
prakr̥tyā sargadharmiṇyā tathā trividhasattvayā
vivakṣatā vā sadvākyaṁ dharmaṁ sūkṣmam avekṣatā
vaimanasyaṁ ca viṣaye yānty asya karaṇāni ca
antakāle hy upāsannās tapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ
saṁjātair jāyate gātraiḥ karmajair brahmaṇā vr̥taḥ
sarveṣām eva bhūtānāṁ puruṣaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate
śarīravān upādatte mohāt sarvaparigrahān
yathāgamaṁ ca tat sarvaṁ buddhyā tan naiva budhyate
dehāntaṁ kaś cid anvāste bhāvitātmā nirāśrayaḥ
purīṣamūtravikledaśoṇitaprabhavāvilam
tr̥ṣṇābaddhaṁ jagat sarvaṁ cakravat parivartate
yat kr̥taṁ prāk śubhaṁ karma pāpaṁ vā tad upāśnute
yugānte ’ntarhitān vedān setihāsān maharṣayaḥ
śritā virajasaṁ devaṁ yam āhuḥ paramaṁ padam
sattvasthaḥ sāttvikān bhāvāñ śuddhān paśyati saṁśritaḥ
na tv eṣām arthasāmānyam antareṇa guṇān imān
śukraṁ saṁkalpajaṁ nr̥̄ṇāṁ sarvagātrair vimuñcati
rajasy antarhitā mūrtir indriyāṇāṁ sanātanī
madhu tailaṁ payaḥ sarpir māṁsāni lavaṇaṁ guḍaḥ
devarṣicaritaṁ gārgyaḥ kr̥ṣṇātreyaś cikitsitam
majjāṁ caiva sirājālais tarpayanti rasā nr̥ṇām
kaṣāyavarjitaṁ jñānaṁ yeṣām utpadyate ’calam
tyāgāt tebhyo nirodhaḥ syān nirodhajño vimucyate
tat tat svapne ’py uparate manodr̥ṣṭir nirīkṣate
antarikṣād anyataraṁ dhāraṇāsaktamānasam
jyotiṣmad virajo divyam atra siddhaṁ mahātmanām
rajobhūtair hi karaṇaiḥ karmaṇā pratipadyate
saṁsāratantravāhinyas tatra budhyeta yoṣitaḥ
mānavā jñānasaṁmohāt tataḥ kāmaṁ prayānti vai
tasmāt tad avighātāya karma kuryād akalmaṣam
etad devāsurair guptaṁ tad āhur jñānalakṣaṇam
puruṣaṁ sanātanaṁ viṣṇuṁ yat tad vedavido viduḥ
rajastamobhyāṁ nirmuktaṁ sattvaṁ nirmalatām iyāt
anyonyam abhivartante puruṣādhiṣṭhitāḥ sadā
yat tat sadasad avyaktaṁ svapity asmin nidarśanam
vyaktāvyakte ca yat tattvaṁ saṁprāptaṁ paramarṣiṇā
śrotreṇa śravaṇaṁ caiva cakṣuṣā caiva darśanam
virāgā dagdhadoṣās te nāpnuyur dehasaṁbhavam
adhyātmaṁ sarvabhūtānām āgamānāṁ ca yad vasu
tat sarvaṁ dehināṁ bījaṁ sarvam ātmavataḥ samam
avyaktapuruṣābhyāṁ tu yat syād anyan mahattaram
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṁ tad adhyātmaguṇaṁ viduḥ
vyāpakaṁ sarvabhūteṣu vartate ’pratighaṁ manaḥ
evaṁ yuktena manasā jñānaṁ tad upapadyate
pāpmānaṁ nirdahed evam antarbhūtaṁ rajomayam
īdr̥g alpaṁ ca vaktavyam avikṣiptena cetasā
etān sattvaguṇān vidyād imān rājasatāmasān
pr̥thaktvāt saṁprayogāc ca nāsūyur veda śāśvatam
śārīrair niyamair ugraiś caren niṣkalmaṣaṁ tapaḥ
sūryaś ca candramāś caiva bhāsatas tapasā divi
sāttviko vā yathāyogam ānantaryaphalodayaḥ
manasas tu pralīnatvāt tat tad āhur nidarśanam
tathā rajastamaḥkarmāṇy utsr̥jya prāpnuyāt sukham
sarvabhūtaviśiṣṭās te sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ
kāmakrodhādibhir bhāvair yukto rājasatāmasaiḥ
parapratyayasarge tu niyataṁ nātivartate
jñānendriyāṇy ataḥ pañca pañca karmendriyāṇy api
bhagavantam ajaṁ divyaṁ viṣṇum avyaktasaṁjñitam
hetumac chakyam ākhyātum etāvaj jñānacakṣuṣā
deheṣu jñānakartāram upāsīnam upāsate
dvijāgryo jāyate vidvān kanyasīṁ vr̥ttim āsthitaḥ
kr̥tyā hy etā ghorarūpā mohayanty avicakṣaṇān
tasmād etā viśeṣeṇa naro ’tīyur vipaścitaḥ
mr̥nmayaṁ śaraṇaṁ yadvan mr̥daiva parilipyate
sukhaduḥkhasamārambhāj janmājanmakr̥takṣaṇāḥ
sudurgam iva panthānam atītya guṇabandhanam
anādyantāv ubhāv etāv aliṅgau cāpy ubhāv api
svapnayoge yathaivātmā pañcendriyasamāgataḥ
atha vā na pravarteta yogatantrair upakramet
iyaṁ sā buddhir anyeyaṁ yayā yāti parāṁ gatim
ajñānaprabhavaṁ nityam ahaṁkāraṁ parityajet
saṁdeham etam utpannam acchinad bhagavān r̥ṣiḥ
abhyasyanti paraṁ devaṁ vidyutsaṁśabditākṣaram
pravr̥ttiḥ punarāvr̥ttir nivr̥ttiḥ paramā gatiḥ
śukrato rasataś caiva snehāj jāyanti jantavaḥ
tasmāc chubhāni karmāṇi kuryād vāgbuddhikarmabhiḥ
na bhūḥ khaṁ dyaur na bhūtāni narṣayo na surāsurāḥ
indriyāṇāṁ rajasy eva prabhavapralayāv ubhau
vimr̥śed ātmasaṁsthānām ekaikam anusaṁtatam
prasannair indriyair yad yat saṁkalpayati mānasam
kāryair avyāhatamatir vairāgyāt prakr̥tau sthitaḥ
tāṁs tān upāsate dharmān dharmakāmā yathāgamam
kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṁ cakraṁ snigdhākṣaṁ vartate dhruvam
vāṅmanoniyamaḥ sāmyaṁ mānasaṁ tapa ucyate
agrāhyau puruṣāv etāv aliṅgatvād asaṁhitau
dharmyaṁ panthānam ākramya sānubandho vinaśyati
bhāvān sarvān yathāvr̥ttān saṁvaseta yathākramam
dhr̥timān ātmavān buddhiṁ nigr̥hṇīyād asaṁśayam
rajastamobhavair bhāvais tad apy āhur duranvayam
trailokyaṁ sarvabhūteṣu cakravat parivartate
svabhāvāt karmayogād vā tān upekṣeta buddhimān
pravr̥ttaṁ noparundheta śanair agnim ivendhayet
ekas tad veda bhagavān dhātā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
vidyāt tu ṣoḍaśaitāni daivatāni vibhāgaśaḥ
martyalokād vimucyante vidyāsaṁyuktamānasāḥ
pravr̥ttilakṣaṇo dharmo yathāyam upapadyate
yathāsaṁjño hy ayaṁ samyag antakāle na muhyati
tadvad avyaktajā bhāvāḥ kartuḥ kāraṇalakṣaṇāḥ
gāndharvaṁ nārado vedaṁ bharadvājo dhanurgraham
niṣpracāreṇa manasā paraṁ tad adhigacchati
karmaṇā bījabhūtena codyate yad yad indriyam
navadvāraṁ puraṁ puṇyam etair bhāvaiḥ samanvitam
sa tayor apavargajño vītarāgo vimucyate
kāryāṇāṁ tūpakaraṇe kālo bhavati hetumān
yad idaṁ brahmaṇo rūpaṁ brahmacaryam iti smr̥tam
nāgāsuramanuṣyāṁś ca sr̥jate paramo ’vyayaḥ
avyaktakarmajā buddhir ahaṁkāraṁ prasūyate
arthayuktāni cātyarthaṁ kāmān sarvāṁś ca sevate
doṣair mūlād avacchinnair viśuddhātmā vimucyate
viṣādaśokāv aratir mānadarpāv anāryatā
tathaitad upapannārthaṁ varṇayanti maharṣayaḥ
prāpya tat paramaṁ sthānaṁ modante ’kṣaram avyayam
atha yad yad yadā bhāvi kālayogād yugādiṣu
na ca taiḥ spr̥śyate bhāvo na te tena mahātmanā
bhavitā manaso jñānaṁ mana eva pratāyate
ity uktās te tu munayo brahmaṇā guruṇā tathā
tathā vārtāṁ samīkṣeta kr̥talakṣaṇasaṁmitām
tathāpakvakaṣāyākhyaṁ vijñānaṁ na prakāśate
buddhyā hy anigr̥hītena manasā karma tāmasam
prakr̥tyā kṣetrabhūtās tā narāḥ kṣetrajñalakṣaṇāḥ
daśa vidyād dhamanyo ’tra pañcendriyaguṇāvahāḥ
pratyāhāreṇa vā śakyam avyaktaṁ brahma veditum
svadehajān asvasaṁjñān yadvad aṅgāt kr̥mīṁs tyajet
śukram asparśajaṁ dehāt sr̥janty asya manovahā
sadbhir ācaritatvāt tu vr̥ttam etad agarhitam
durlabhā vedavidvāṁso vedokteṣu vyavasthitāḥ
kāmakrodhau pramādaś ca lobhamohau bhayaṁ klamaḥ
yadā paśyet tadā doṣān atītyāmr̥tam aśnute
krodhaharṣau viṣādaś ca jāyante hi parasparam
jñānadagdhaparikleśaḥ prayogaratir ātmavān
atha vā mantravad brūyur māṁsādānāṁ yajuṣkr̥tam
saṁtanvānā yathā yānti tathā dehāḥ śarīriṇām
prītiduḥkhanibaddhāṁś ca samastāṁs trīn atho guṇān
ye vai śukragatiṁ vidyur bhūtasaṁkarakārikām
sa tu dehād yathā dehaṁ tyaktvānyaṁ pratipadyate
vijñeyaṁ vyāpakaṁ cittaṁ teṣu sarvagataṁ manaḥ
vidhijñebhyo dvijātibhyo grāhyam annaṁ viśiṣyate
tābhiḥ saṁsaktamanaso brahmavat saṁprakāśate
kam abhiṣṭuvate cāyaṁ kaṁ vā krośati kiṁ vadet
vyāpya śete mahān ātmā tasmāt puruṣa ucyate
tasmān manovākśarīrair ācared dhairyam ātmanaḥ
dehakarma nudan prāṇān antakāle vimucyate
vijñānānugataṁ jñānam ajñānād apakr̥ṣyate
atrāpy upekṣāṁ kurvīta jñātvā karmaphalaṁ jagat
vātapittakaphān raktaṁ tvaṅmāṁsaṁ snāyum asthi ca
yo yathāvad vijānāti sa vitr̥ṣṇo vimucyate
yadvat kāntāram ātiṣṭhan nautsukyaṁ samanuvrajet
nātyeti kāraṇaṁ kāryaṁ na kāryaṁ kāraṇaṁ tathā
ubhau nityau sūkṣmatarau mahadbhyaś ca mahattarau
kāryakāraṇasaṁyoge sa hetur upapāditaḥ
sarajastāmasair bhāvaiś cyuto hetubalānvitaḥ
acetanāś cetayituḥ kāraṇād abhisaṁhitāḥ
nāśuddham ācaret tasmād abhīpsan dehayāpanam
karmaṇā vyāpyate pūrvaṁ karmaṇā copapadyate
trailokyaṁ seśvaraṁ sarvam ahaṁkāre pratiṣṭhitam
śukraṁ nirmathyate tadvad dehasaṁkalpajaiḥ khajaiḥ
trailokyaṁ tapasā vyāptam antarbhūtena bhāsvatā
pravr̥ttilakṣaṇaṁ dharmaṁ prajāpatir athābravīt
sūcyā sūtraṁ yathā vastre saṁsārayati vāyakaḥ
kāmāt krodham avāpyātha lobhamohau ca mānavāḥ
hetuyuktāḥ prakr̥tayo vikārāś ca parasparam
nidrā sarvātmanā tyājyā svapnadoṣān avekṣatā
svapne ’py evaṁ yathābhyeti manaḥsaṁkalpajaṁ rajaḥ
atha vā manasaḥ saṅgaṁ paśyed bhūtānukampayā
rajastamoghnaṁ yat karma tapasas tat svalakṣaṇam
yadvan manorathaiśvaryaṁ svapne tadvan manogatam
atraivāvasthitaṁ sarvaṁ trailokyaṁ sacarācaram
tad vijñānāc caran prājñaḥ prāpnuyāt paramāṁ gatim
tasmāt tarṣātmakād rāgād bījāj jāyanti jantavaḥ
jāyate tad ahaṁkārād rāgayuktena cetasā
vākprabuddho hi saṁrāgād virāgād vyāhared yadi
puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṁ bhāvaṁ prakr̥tiḥ sūyate sadā
nigr̥hītendriyasyāsya kurvāṇasya mano vaśe
bhavāntaprabhavaprajñā āsate ye viparyayam
cakravat parivartante hy ajñānāj jantavo bhr̥śam
samyagvr̥ttir brahmalokaṁ prāpnuyān madhyamaḥ surān
hiṁsāvihārābhiratas tandrīnidrāsamanvitaḥ
sa duḥkhaṁ prāpya loke ’smin narakāyopapadyate
vayotīto jarāmr̥tyū jitvā brahma sanātanam
śramād āhāram ādadyād asvādv api hi yāpanam
tasmāt tanmātram ādadyād yāvad atra prayojanam
dr̥ṣṭvemaṁ saṁtataṁ lokaṁ ghaṭen mokṣāya buddhimān
tat kāraṇair hi saṁyuktaṁ kāryasaṁgrahakārakam
atrocyate yathā hy etad veda yogeśvaro hariḥ
tathaitad antaraṁ vidyāt kṣetrakṣetrajñayor budhaḥ
kṣamā caivāpramādaś ca yasyaite sa sukhī bhavet
tasmād ātmavatā varjyaṁ rajaś ca tama eva ca
tathaiva vedaśāstrāṇi lokadharmāṁś ca śāśvatān
dhr̥tyā dehān dhārayanto buddhisaṁkṣiptamānasāḥ
sattvena rajasā caiva tamasā caiva mohitāḥ
lebhire tapasā pūrvam anujñātāḥ svayaṁbhuvā
dehaṁ tu paramaṁ vidyād vimuktam aparigraham
dhānyāni phalamūlāni mr̥dvikārāḥ sahāmbhasā
śr̥ṇu śiṣya mahāprājña brahmaguhyam idaṁ param
niṣkalmaṣaṁ brahmacaryam icchatā carituṁ sadā
satyāṁ vācam ahiṁsrāṁ ca vaded anapavādinīm
hetuḥ sa evānādāne śuddhadharmānupālane
prakr̥teś ca vikārāṇāṁ draṣṭāram aguṇānvitam
nivr̥ttilakṣaṇaṁ dharmam avyaktaṁ brahma śāśvatam
kīrtyate śabdasaṁjñābhiḥ ko ’ham eṣo ’py asāv iti
tasmāc catuṣṭayaṁ vedyam etair hetubhir ācitam
vināśayati saṁbhūtam ayasmayamayo yathā
svapne hi rajasā dehī tamasā cābhibhūyate
tr̥ṣṇātantur anādyantas tathā dehagataḥ sadā
yukto dhāraṇayā kaś cit sattāṁ ke cid upāsate
vikāraṁ prakr̥tiṁ caiva puruṣaṁ ca sanātanam
parīkṣya saṁcared vidvān yathāvac chāstracakṣuṣā
avyaktaprabhavāny āhur avyaktanidhanāni ca
rajas tamasi paryastaṁ sattvaṁ tamasi saṁsthitam
karaṇaiḥ karmanirvr̥ttaiḥ kartā yad yad viceṣṭate
yaś cainaṁ paramaṁ dharmaṁ sarvabhūtasukhāvaham
vedavid veda bhagavān vedāṅgāni br̥haspatiḥ
tamasā lobhayuktāni krodhajāni ca sevate
buddhyā ca vyavasāyena brahmacaryam akalmaṣam
tad bījaṁ dehinām āhus tad bījaṁ jīvasaṁjñitam
vyānodānau samānaś ca pañcadhā dehayāpanā
saṁmohakaṁ tamo vidyāt kr̥ṣṇam ajñānasaṁbhavam
prakr̥tiḥ sr̥jate tadvad ānantyān nāpacīyate
suduṣkaraṁ brahmacaryam upāyaṁ tatra me śr̥ṇu
tasmāt samāhitaṁ buddhyā mano bhūteṣu dhārayet
sattvaṁ devaguṇaṁ vidyād itarāv āsurau guṇau
āhāraniyamenāsya pāpmā naśyati rājasaḥ
yoṣitāṁ na kathāḥ śrāvyā na nirīkṣyā nirambarāḥ
sa dehī vimalaḥ śrīmāñ śuddho vidyāsamanvitaḥ
bisatantur yathaivāyam antaḥsthaḥ sarvato bise
duḥkhaṁ vidyād upādānād abhimānāc ca vardhate
anādyaṁ yat paraṁ brahma na devā narṣayo viduḥ
yathartuṣv r̥tuliṅgāni nānārūpāṇi paryaye
nyāyatantrāṇy anekāni tais tair uktāni vādibhiḥ
netrahīno yathā hy ekaḥ kr̥cchrāṇi labhate ’dhvani
tathākr̥tātmā sahajair doṣair naśyati rājasaiḥ
evaṁ hi tapasā yuktam arkavat tamasaḥ param
devatās tāḥ prakāśante hr̥ṣṭā yānti tam īśvaram
vāṅmanobhyāṁ śarīreṇa śuciḥ syād anahaṁkr̥taḥ
rasajñāne tu jihveyaṁ vyāhr̥te vāk tathaiva ca
magnaḥ svapne ca manasā trir japed aghamarṣaṇam
deham utsr̥jya vai yāti tathaivātropalabhyate
ete bhāvā jagat sarvaṁ vahanti sacarācaram
jñānahīnas tathā loke tasmāj jñānavido ’dhikāḥ
duḥkhādyantair duḥkhamadhyair naraḥ śārīramānasaiḥ
tathā taṁ saṁpravakṣyāmi bhūtagrāmaṁ svakarmajam
tāṁ gatiṁ paramām eti nivr̥ttiparamo muniḥ
jñānendriyāṇīndriyārthān nopasarpanty atarṣulam
rajasy antarhitā mūrtir indriyāṇāṁ sanātanī
nivr̥ttilakṣaṇaṁ dharmam avyaktaṁ brahma śāśvatam
svapne hi rajasā dehī tamasā cābhibhūyate
adhyātmaṁ sarvabhūtānām āgamānāṁ ca yad vasu
parīkṣya saṁcared vidvān yathāvac chāstracakṣuṣā
rāgotpattau caret kr̥cchram ahnas triḥ praviśed apaḥ
jñānahīnas tathā loke tasmāj jñānavido ’dhikāḥ
nātyeti kāraṇaṁ kāryaṁ na kāryaṁ kāraṇaṁ tathā
nāvagacchanty avijñānād ātmajaṁ pārthivaṁ guṇam
paraṁ tat sarvabhūtebhyas tena yānti parāṁ gatim
sa tu dehād yathā dehaṁ tyaktvānyaṁ pratipadyate
rasajñāne tu jihveyaṁ vyāhr̥te vāk tathaiva ca
kr̥tavanto mahātmānas tato lokān avāpnuvan
arthayuktāni cātyarthaṁ kāmān sarvāṁś ca sevate
yathāśvatthakaṇīkāyām antarbhūto mahādrumaḥ
ye tv asaktā mahātmānas te yānti paramāṁ gatim
yatheha niyataṁ kālo darśayaty ārtavān guṇān
duḥkhān niḥsaraṇaṁ veda sa tattvajñaḥ sukhī bhavet
vaimanasyaṁ ca viṣaye yānty asya karaṇāni ca
karma tat kurute tarṣād ahaṁkāraparigraham
magnaḥ svapne ca manasā trir japed aghamarṣaṇam
sparśanebhyas tathā vāyuḥ prāṇāpānavyapāśrayaḥ
purīṣamūtravikledaśoṇitaprabhavāvilam
yathāgamaṁ ca tat sarvaṁ buddhyā tan naiva budhyate
yukto dhāraṇayā kaś cit sattāṁ ke cid upāsate
tasmāt samāhitaṁ buddhyā mano bhūteṣu dhārayet
amr̥taṁ tad avāpnoti yat tad akṣaram avyayam
jñānādhiṣṭhānam ajñānaṁ trīm̐l lokān adhitiṣṭhati
māhātmyaṁ devadevasya viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ
prakr̥tiḥ sr̥jate tadvad ānantyān nāpacīyate
kr̥tyā hy etā ghorarūpā mohayanty avicakṣaṇān
yoṣitāṁ na kathāḥ śrāvyā na nirīkṣyā nirambarāḥ
sāttviko vā yathāyogam ānantaryaphalodayaḥ
brahmacaryam ahiṁsā ca śārīraṁ tapa ucyate
jñānadagdhais tathā kleśair nātmā saṁbadhyate punaḥ
sarajastāmasair bhāvaiś cyuto hetubalānvitaḥ
nadīṣv āpo yathā yuktā yathā sūrye marīcayaḥ
trailokyaṁ seśvaraṁ sarvam ahaṁkāre pratiṣṭhitam
ubhau nityau sūkṣmatarau mahadbhyaś ca mahattarau
sarvadharmeṣu dharmajñā jñāpayanti guṇān imān
agnir dārugato yadvad bhinne dārau na dr̥śyate
atha vā na pravarteta yogatantrair upakramet
vāṅmanobhyāṁ śarīreṇa śuciḥ syād anahaṁkr̥taḥ
rajasā sādhyate mohas tamasā ca nararṣabha
śabdarāgāc chrotram asya jāyate bhāvitātmanaḥ
śukram asparśajaṁ dehāt sr̥janty asya manovahā
bhavitā manaso jñānaṁ mana eva pratāyate
tasmāc chubhāni karmāṇi kuryād vāgbuddhikarmabhiḥ
yad idaṁ brahmaṇo rūpaṁ brahmacaryam iti smr̥tam
tr̥ṣṇābaddhaṁ jagat sarvaṁ cakravat parivartate
pravr̥ttilakṣaṇo dharmo yathāyam upapadyate
vijñeyaṁ vyāpakaṁ cittaṁ teṣu sarvagataṁ manaḥ
īdr̥g alpaṁ ca vaktavyam avikṣiptena cetasā
rajas tamasi paryastaṁ sattvaṁ tamasi saṁsthitam
mānavā jñānasaṁmohāt tataḥ kāmaṁ prayānti vai
pāpmānaṁ nirdahed evam antarbhūtaṁ rajomayam
buddhyā hy anigr̥hītena manasā karma tāmasam
sargapralayakartāram avyaktaṁ brahma śāśvatam
tvam apy etan mahābhāga yathoktaṁ brahmaṇo vacaḥ
tathā rajastamaḥkarmāṇy utsr̥jya prāpnuyāt sukham
etān sattvaguṇān vidyād imān rājasatāmasān
acetanāś cetayituḥ kāraṇād abhisaṁhitāḥ
sūkṣmaṁ viśeṣaṇaṁ teṣām avekṣec chāstracakṣuṣā
jñānendriyāṇy ataḥ pañca pañca karmendriyāṇy api
puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṁ bhāvaṁ prakr̥tiḥ sūyate sadā
svadehajān asvasaṁjñān yadvad aṅgāt kr̥mīṁs tyajet
bījāny agnyupadagdhāni na rohanti yathā punaḥ
atha yad yad yadā bhāvi kālayogād yugādiṣu
tathā mūlaphalaṁ bhaikṣaṁ paryāyeṇopayojayet
suduṣkaraṁ brahmacaryam upāyaṁ tatra me śr̥ṇu
saṁpravr̥ttam udīrṇaṁ ca nigr̥hṇīyād dvijo manaḥ
viviktacārī laghvāśī tapasvī niyatendriyaḥ
agrāhyau puruṣāv etāv aliṅgatvād asaṁhitau
atha vā mantravad brūyur māṁsādānāṁ yajuṣkr̥tam
indriyair vividhair yuktaṁ sarvaṁ vyastaṁ manas tathā
śukraṁ saṁkalpajaṁ nr̥̄ṇāṁ sarvagātrair vimuñcati
pr̥thaktvāt saṁprayogāc ca nāsūyur veda śāśvatam
na bhūḥ khaṁ dyaur na bhūtāni narṣayo na surāsurāḥ
hetvāgamasadācārair yad uktaṁ tad upāsyate
śritā virajasaṁ devaṁ yam āhuḥ paramaṁ padam
snigdhatvāt tilavat sarvaṁ cakre ’smin pīḍyate jagat
sattvaṁ devaguṇaṁ vidyād itarāv āsurau guṇau
rūparāgāt tathā cakṣur ghrāṇaṁ gandhacikīrṣayā
yadvan manorathaiśvaryaṁ svapne tadvan manogatam
tathā vārtāṁ samīkṣeta kr̥talakṣaṇasaṁmitām
deham utsr̥jya vai yāti tathaivātropalabhyate
yadā paśyet tadā doṣān atītyāmr̥tam aśnute
tilapīḍair ivākramya bhogair ajñānasaṁbhavaiḥ
bhāvān sarvān yathāvr̥ttān saṁvaseta yathākramam
yābhiḥ sūkṣmāḥ pratāyante dhamanyo ’nyāḥ sahasraśaḥ
jñānātmānaṁ tathā vidyāt puruṣaṁ sarvajantuṣu
abhyāsāt sa tathā yukto na gacchet prakr̥tiṁ punaḥ
atrāha ko nv ayaṁ bhāvaḥ svapne viṣayavān iva
buddhyā ca vyavasāyena brahmacaryam akalmaṣam
tān eva ca yathā dasyūn kṣiptvā gacchec chivāṁ diśam
guṇānām api yad yat tat karma jānāty upasthitam
gāndharvaṁ nārado vedaṁ bharadvājo dhanurgraham
svabhāvāt karmayogād vā tān upekṣeta buddhimān
kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṁ cakraṁ snigdhākṣaṁ vartate dhruvam
paramaṁ paramātmānaṁ devam akṣayam avyayam
duḥkhādyantair duḥkhamadhyair naraḥ śārīramānasaiḥ
mr̥nmayaṁ śaraṇaṁ yadvan mr̥daiva parilipyate
dhr̥timān ātmavān buddhiṁ nigr̥hṇīyād asaṁśayam
tathaiva vedaśāstrāṇi lokadharmāṁś ca śāśvatān
lohayuktaṁ yathā hema vipakvaṁ na virājate
jihvayā rasanaṁ yac ca tad eva parivarjitam
na ca taiḥ spr̥śyate bhāvo na te tena mahātmanā
prakr̥tyā sargadharmiṇyā tathā trividhasattvayā
karmaṇā kālayuktena saṁsāraparivartakam
taṁ viśeṣam avekṣeta viśeṣeṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ
ity uktās te tu munayo brahmaṇā guruṇā tathā
martyalokād vimucyante vidyāsaṁyuktamānasāḥ
nigr̥hītendriyasyāsya kurvāṇasya mano vaśe
jñānābhyāsāj jāgarato jijñāsārtham anantaram
kāraṇaṁ tasya deho ’yaṁ sa kartā sarvakarmaṇām
nāpadhyāyen na spr̥hayen nābaddhaṁ cintayed asat
tad vijñānāc caran prājñaḥ prāpnuyāt paramāṁ gatim
abhyasyanti paraṁ devaṁ vidyutsaṁśabditākṣaram
dehaṁ tu paramaṁ vidyād vimuktam aparigraham
tat kāraṇair hi saṁyuktaṁ kāryasaṁgrahakārakam
atrāpy upekṣāṁ kurvīta jñātvā karmaphalaṁ jagat
satyaṁ dānam atho yajñas titikṣā dama ārjavam
prayojanam atas tv atra mārgam icchanti saṁstutam
tathaitad upapannārthaṁ varṇayanti maharṣayaḥ
āhāraṁ niyataṁ caiva deśe kāle ca sāttvikam
prasannair indriyair yad yat saṁkalpayati mānasam
tadvat saṁsārasūtraṁ hi tr̥ṣṇāsūcyā nibadhyate
tad idaṁ brahma vārṣṇeyam itihāsaṁ śr̥ṇuṣva me
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṁ tasmād budhyeta buddhimān
nārāyaṇād r̥ṣigaṇās tathā mukhyāḥ surāsurāḥ
viparītam ato vidyāt kṣetrajñasya ca lakṣaṇam
nāgāsuramanuṣyāṁś ca sr̥jate paramo ’vyayaḥ
vyāpakaḥ saguṇaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sarvabhūtaguṇāśrayaḥ
kṣāntyā dhr̥tyā ca buddhyā ca manasā tapasaiva ca
pitr̥̄n devān r̥ṣīṁś caiva tathā vai yakṣadānavān
trailokyaṁ sarvabhūteṣu cakravat parivartate
viṣayāḥ pañca caikaṁ ca vikāre ṣoḍaśaṁ manaḥ
ye vidur bhāvitātmānas te yānti paramāṁ gatim
bhavāntaprabhavaprajñā āsate ye viparyayam
manaḥ sattvaguṇaṁ prāhuḥ sattvam avyaktajaṁ tathā
hetumac chakyam ākhyātum etāvaj jñānacakṣuṣā
antakāle vayotkarṣāc chanaiḥ kuryād anāturaḥ
tasmād etā viśeṣeṇa naro ’tīyur vipaścitaḥ
pralaye prakr̥tiṁ prāpya yugādau sr̥jate prabhuḥ
śāntim icchann adīnātmā saṁyacched indriyāṇi ca
tadvad dehagataṁ vidyād ātmānaṁ dehabandhanam
devatās tāḥ prakāśante hr̥ṣṭā yānti tam īśvaram
vadanti puruṣavyāghraṁ keśavaṁ puruṣarṣabham
doṣāṇām evamādīnāṁ parīkṣya gurulāghavam
puruṣaṁ sanātanaṁ viṣṇuṁ yat tad vedavido viduḥ
uṣṇīṣavān yathā vastrais tribhir bhavati saṁvr̥taḥ
tat tac chaṁsanti bhūtāni mano yad bhāvitaṁ yathā
abhidravaty ayaskāntam ayo niścetanāv ubhau
tadvad avyaktajā bhāvāḥ kartuḥ kāraṇalakṣaṇāḥ
jñānadagdhaparikleśaḥ prayogaratir ātmavān
kāryavyāsaktamanasaḥ saṁkalpo jāgrato hy api
sarvagātrapratāyinyas tasyā hy anugatāḥ sirāḥ
pravr̥ttaṁ noparundheta śanair agnim ivendhayet
pañcabhūtātmake dehe sattvarājasatāmase
kaṇapiṇyākakulmāṣaśākayāvakasaktavaḥ
avyaktanābhaṁ vyaktāraṁ vikāraparimaṇḍalam
sadbhir ācaritatvāt tu vr̥ttam etad agarhitam
majjāṁ caiva sirājālais tarpayanti rasā nr̥ṇām
evaṁ hi tapasā yuktam arkavat tamasaḥ param
viṣṇum avyaktasaṁsthānaṁ viśante devasattamam
tat sarvaṁ dehināṁ bījaṁ sarvam ātmavataḥ samam
anyonyam abhivartante puruṣādhiṣṭhitāḥ sadā
vyānodānau samānaś ca pañcadhā dehayāpanā
pārthivo ’yaṁ tathā deho mr̥dvikārair vilipyate
svasaṁjñān asvajāṁs tadvat sutasaṁjñān kr̥mīṁs tyajet
dr̥ṣṭvemaṁ saṁtataṁ lokaṁ ghaṭen mokṣāya buddhimān
na sa veda paraṁ dharmaṁ yo na veda catuṣṭayam
deheṣu jñānakartāram upāsīnam upāsate
śramād āhāram ādadyād asvādv api hi yāpanam
avyaktaprabhavāny āhur avyaktanidhanāni ca
rājarṣayaḥ purāṇāś ca paramaṁ duḥkhabheṣajam
mahābhūtānīndriyāṇi guṇāḥ sattvaṁ rajas tamaḥ
tasmāt tad avighātāya karma kuryād akalmaṣam
duḥkhaṁ vidyād upādānād abhimānāc ca vardhate
kṣetrajñam evānuyāti pāṁsur vāterito yathā
bhagavantam ajaṁ divyaṁ viṣṇum avyaktasaṁjñitam
madhye ca hr̥dayasyaikā sirā tv atra manovahā
sūcyā sūtraṁ yathā vastre saṁsārayati vāyakaḥ
guṇānāṁ sāmyam āgamya manasaiva manovaham
paripakvabuddhiḥ kālena ādatte mānasaṁ balam
yenaitad vartate cakram anādinidhanaṁ mahat
dehāntaṁ kaś cid anvāste bhāvitātmā nirāśrayaḥ
kāmakrodhādibhir bhāvair yukto rājasatāmasaiḥ
janmamr̥tyujarāduḥkhair vyādhibhir manasaḥ klamaiḥ
sa dehī vimalaḥ śrīmāñ śuddho vidyāsamanvitaḥ
bhūtānām anukampārthaṁ jagāda jagato hitam
vātapittakaphān raktaṁ tvaṅmāṁsaṁ snāyum asthi ca
karaṇaiḥ karmanirvr̥ttaiḥ kartā yad yad viceṣṭate
tamasā lobhayuktāni krodhajāni ca sevate
puruṣebhyo dvijān āhur dvijebhyo mantravādinaḥ
niṣpanno dr̥śyate vyaktam avyaktāt saṁbhavas tathā
ete bhāvā jagat sarvaṁ vahanti sacarācaram
brahmabhūtā virajasas tato yānti parāṁ gatim
trailokyaprakr̥tir dehī tapasā taṁ maheśvaram
jñātvātmasthaṁ hariṁ caiva nivartante na te ’vyayāḥ
tābhiḥ saṁsaktamanaso brahmavat saṁprakāśate
pratāpas tapaso jñānaṁ loke saṁśabditaṁ tapaḥ
etad devāsurair guptaṁ tad āhur jñānalakṣaṇam
jñānendhitaṁ tato jñānam arkavat saṁprakāśate
yathāsaṁjño hy ayaṁ samyag antakāle na muhyati
sarvanītyā sarvagataṁ manohetu salakṣaṇam
teṣāṁ vijñānaniṣṭhānām anyat tattvaṁ na rocate
pravr̥ttilakṣaṇaṁ dharmam r̥ṣir nārāyaṇo ’bravīt
bisatantur yathaivāyam antaḥsthaḥ sarvato bise
mānadarpād ahaṁkāram ahaṁkārāt tataḥ kriyāḥ
ākāśaṁ cāpy ahaṁkārād vāyur ākāśasaṁbhavaḥ
karmagarbhair guṇair dehī garbhe tad upapadyate
kāmakrodhau pramādaś ca lobhamohau bhayaṁ klamaḥ
satyāṁ vācam ahiṁsrāṁ ca vaded anapavādinīm
tat tat svapne ’py uparate manodr̥ṣṭir nirīkṣate
niḥsaṁdigdham anīho vai muktaḥ sarvaparigrahaiḥ
etaiś cāpagataiḥ sarvair brahmabhūyāya kalpate
maharṣir bhagavān atrir veda tac chukrasaṁbhavam
dehāntaram ivāpannaś caraty apagatasmr̥tiḥ
trailokyaṁ tapasā vyāptam antarbhūtena bhāsvatā
pratyāhāreṇa vā śakyam avyaktaṁ brahma veditum
krodhalobhau bhayaṁ darpa eteṣāṁ sādhanāc chuciḥ
kāryair avyāhatamatir vairāgyāt prakr̥tau sthitaḥ
ramaty ayaṁ yathā svapne manasā dehavān iva
prāpya tat paramaṁ sthānaṁ modante ’kṣaram avyayam
vyāpya śete mahān ātmā tasmāt puruṣa ucyate
avyaktakarmajā buddhir ahaṁkāraṁ prasūyate
vidhijñebhyo dvijātibhyo grāhyam annaṁ viśiṣyate
dharmyaṁ panthānam ākramya sānubandho vinaśyati
pravr̥ttiḥ punarāvr̥ttir nivr̥ttiḥ paramā gatiḥ
parapratyayasarge tu niyataṁ nātivartate
manasy antarhitaṁ sarvaṁ veda sottamapūruṣaḥ
sarvabhūtaviśiṣṭās te sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ
vijñānānugataṁ jñānam ajñānād apakr̥ṣyate
tr̥ṣṇābhibhūtas tair baddhas tān evābhipariplavan
svabhāvahetujā bhāvā yadvad anyad apīdr̥śam
prakīrṇameṣabhāro hi yadvad dhāryeta dasyubhiḥ
ye vai śukragatiṁ vidyur bhūtasaṁkarakārikām
yadvat kāntāram ātiṣṭhan nautsukyaṁ samanuvrajet
lipseta manasā yaś ca saṁkalpād aiśvaraṁ guṇam
nāśuddham ācaret tasmād abhīpsan dehayāpanam
yaś cādharmaṁ caren mohāt kāmalobhāv anu plavan
indriyāṇāṁ rajasy eva prabhavapralayāv ubhau
samyagvr̥ttir brahmalokaṁ prāpnuyān madhyamaḥ surān
tadvat somaguṇā jihvā gandhas tu pr̥thivīguṇaḥ
netrahīno yathā hy ekaḥ kr̥cchrāṇi labhate ’dhvani
sūryaś ca candramāś caiva bhāsatas tapasā divi
kaṣāyavarjitaṁ jñānaṁ yeṣām utpadyate ’calam
tāṁs tān upāsate dharmān dharmakāmā yathāgamam
sparśaṁ vāyuguṇaṁ vidyāt sarvabhūteṣu sarvadā
saṁyogalakṣaṇotpattiḥ karmajā gr̥hyate yayā
vijñānābhiniveśāt tu jāgaraty aniśaṁ sadā
sudurgam iva panthānam atītya guṇabandhanam
krodhaharṣau viṣādaś ca jāyante hi parasparam
yena tantramayaṁ tantraṁ vr̥ttiḥ syāt tat tad ācaret
sattvena rajasā caiva tamasā caiva mohitāḥ
karmaṇā nīyate ’nyatra svakr̥tena balīyasā
sāmānyam etad ubhayor evaṁ hy anyad viśeṣaṇam
rajasā dharmayuktāni kāryāṇy api samāpnuyāt
rājasaṁ tāmasaṁ caiva śuddhātmākarmasaṁbhavam
vāsudevaḥ sarvam idaṁ viśvasya brahmaṇo mukham
sattvasya rajasaś caiva tamasaś ca nibodha tān
śārīrair niyamair ugraiś caren niṣkalmaṣaṁ tapaḥ
duranteṣv indriyārtheṣu saktāḥ sīdanti jantavaḥ
kāmāt krodham avāpyātha lobhamohau ca mānavāḥ
jñānatattvaparo nityaṁ śubhāśubhanidarśakaḥ
kāryāṇāṁ tūpakaraṇe kālo bhavati hetumān
tasmāc catuṣṭayaṁ vedyam etair hetubhir ācitam
tasmān manovākśarīrair ācared dhairyam ātmanaḥ
devarṣicaritaṁ gārgyaḥ kr̥ṣṇātreyaś cikitsitam
tathāpakvakaṣāyākhyaṁ vijñānaṁ na prakāśate
jāyate tad ahaṁkārād rāgayuktena cetasā
saṁvr̥to ’yaṁ tathā dehī sattvarājasatāmasaiḥ
kalkāpetām aparuṣām anr̥śaṁsām apaiśunām
lebhire tapasā pūrvam anujñātāḥ svayaṁbhuvā
tasya māyāvidagdhāṅgā jñānabhraṣṭā nirāśiṣaḥ
praśānto jñānavān bhikṣur nirapekṣaś caret sukham
sarajasko ’rajaskaś ca sa vai vāyur yathā bhavet
karmaṇā bījabhūtena codyate yad yad indriyam
saṁdeham etam utpannam acchinad bhagavān r̥ṣiḥ
vāgdehamanasāṁ śaucaṁ kṣamā satyaṁ dhr̥tiḥ smr̥tiḥ
virāgā dagdhadoṣās te nāpnuyur dehasaṁbhavam
bhāvena yānti śuddhā ye jñānatr̥ptā nirāśiṣaḥ
yathā dīpaḥ prakāśātmā hrasvo vā yadi vā mahān
dhānyāni phalamūlāni mr̥dvikārāḥ sahāmbhasā
kadā cid darśanād āsāṁ durbalān āviśed rajaḥ
kṣamā caivāpramādaś ca yasyaite sa sukhī bhavet
netrayoḥ pratipadyante vahantyas taijasaṁ guṇam
hetuyuktāḥ prakr̥tayo vikārāś ca parasparam
pādau pāyur upasthaś ca hastau vāk karmaṇām api
yātrārtham adyād āhāraṁ vyādhito bheṣajaṁ yathā
yathartuṣv r̥tuliṅgāni nānārūpāṇi paryaye
vyaktaṁ mr̥tyumukhaṁ vidyād avyaktam amr̥taṁ padam
ajñānaprabhavaṁ nityam ahaṁkāraṁ parityajet
śukrato rasataś caiva snehāj jāyanti jantavaḥ
kīrtyate śabdasaṁjñābhiḥ ko ’ham eṣo ’py asāv iti
yugānte ’ntarhitān vedān setihāsān maharṣayaḥ
dhr̥tyā dehān dhārayanto buddhisaṁkṣiptamānasāḥ
vyāpakaṁ sarvabhūteṣu vartate ’pratighaṁ manaḥ
na tv eṣām arthasāmānyam antareṇa guṇān imān
brāhmaṇā vedatattvajñās tattvārthagatiniścayāḥ
rajobhūtair hi karaṇaiḥ karmaṇā pratipadyate
caturvidhāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
liṅgasaṁyogahīnaṁ yac charīrasparśavarjitam
jñātaiś ca kāraṇair dehī na dehaṁ punar arhati
nidrā sarvātmanā tyājyā svapnadoṣān avekṣatā
nānyad āsīd r̥te jīvam āsedur na tu saṁhitam
śukraṁ nirmathyate tadvad dehasaṁkalpajaiḥ khajaiḥ
doṣair mūlād avacchinnair viśuddhātmā vimucyate
tarpayanti yathākālam āpagā iva sāgaram
antakāle hy upāsannās tapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ
pralīnair indriyair dehī vartate dehavān iva
karmaṇo vivaraṁ kurvan na lokān āpnuyāc chubhān
śabdādīn viṣayāṁs tasmād asaṁrāgād anuplavet
vāṅmanoniyamaḥ sāmyaṁ mānasaṁ tapa ucyate
kālacakram anādyantaṁ bhāvābhāvasvalakṣaṇam
navadvāraṁ puraṁ puṇyam etair bhāvaiḥ samanvitam
mūlaprakr̥tayo ’ṣṭau tā jagad etāsv avasthitam
hetuyuktaḥ sadotsargo bhūtānāṁ pralayas tathā
rajas tamaś ca hitveha na tiryaggatim āpnuyāt
ātmaprabhāvāt taṁ vidyāt sarvā hy ātmani devatāḥ
vidyāt tu ṣoḍaśaitāni daivatāni vibhāgaśaḥ
etāvad etad vijñānam etad asti ca nāsti ca
yat tad akṣaram avyaktam amr̥taṁ brahma śāśvatam
taruṇādhigataṁ jñānaṁ jarādurbalatāṁ gatam
hetuḥ sa evānādāne śuddhadharmānupālane
antarikṣād anyataraṁ dhāraṇāsaktamānasam
śarīravān upādatte mohāt sarvaparigrahān
tyāgāt tebhyo nirodhaḥ syān nirodhajño vimucyate
atraivāvasthitaṁ sarvaṁ trailokyaṁ sacarācaram
satyaśaucārjavatyāgair yaśasā vikrameṇa ca
vāyos tejas tataś cāpas tv adbhyo hi vasudhodgatā
āhāraniyamenāsya pāpmā naśyati rājasaḥ
evam etāḥ sirānadyo rasodā dehasāgaram
prakāśaṁ bhagavān etad r̥ṣir nārāyaṇo ’mr̥tam
vākprabuddho hi saṁrāgād virāgād vyāhared yadi
ajñānakarma nirdiṣṭam etat kāraṇalakṣaṇam
arhas tvam asi kalyāṇa vārṣṇeyaṁ śr̥ṇu yat param
tadvat saṁsārakāntāram ātiṣṭhañ śramatatparaḥ
yaś cainaṁ paramaṁ dharmaṁ sarvabhūtasukhāvaham
vikāraṁ prakr̥tiṁ caiva puruṣaṁ ca sanātanam
niṣpracāreṇa manasā paraṁ tad adhigacchati
śriyaṁ divyām abhiprepsur brahma vāṅmanasā śuciḥ
ahiṁsā satyavacanaṁ sarvabhūteṣu cārjavam
tathākr̥tātmā sahajair doṣair naśyati rājasaiḥ
vyaktāvyakte ca yat tattvaṁ saṁprāptaṁ paramarṣiṇā
saṁsāratantravāhinyas tatra budhyeta yoṣitaḥ
tat parīkṣyānuvarteta yat pravr̥ttyanuvartakam
pratilomāṁ diśaṁ buddhvā saṁsāram abudhās tathā
niṣkalmaṣaṁ brahmacaryam icchatā carituṁ sadā
sattvaṁ rajas tamaś ceti devāsuraguṇān viduḥ
prakr̥teś ca vikārāṇāṁ draṣṭāram aguṇānvitam
kriyābhiḥ snehasaṁbandhaḥ snehāc chokam anantaram
daśa vidyād dhamanyo ’tra pañcendriyaguṇāvahāḥ
anādyantāv ubhāv etāv aliṅgau cāpy ubhāv api
saṁjātair jāyate gātraiḥ karmajair brahmaṇā vr̥taḥ
rajasā cāpy ayaṁ dehī dehavāñ śabdavac caret
nyāyatantrāṇy anekāni tais tair uktāni vādibhiḥ
tasmād ātmavatā varjyaṁ rajaś ca tama eva ca
punaḥ saṁśayam āpannāḥ papracchur dvijasattamāḥ
śr̥ṇu śiṣya mahāprājña brahmaguhyam idaṁ param
kuṇapāmedhyasaṁyuktaṁ yadvad acchidrabandhanam
tat tad utpadyate jñānaṁ lokayātrāvidhānajam
rajastamobhyāṁ nirmuktaṁ sattvaṁ nirmalatām iyāt
prakr̥tyā kṣetrabhūtās tā narāḥ kṣetrajñalakṣaṇāḥ
śrotreṇa śravaṇaṁ caiva cakṣuṣā caiva darśanam
kāryakāraṇasaṁyoge sa hetur upapāditaḥ
ity uktavantaṁ te viprās tadā lokapitāmaham
ekas tad veda bhagavān dhātā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
avāgyogaprayogeṇa manojñaṁ saṁpravartate
tr̥ṣṇātantur anādyantas tathā dehagataḥ sadā
avyaktapuruṣābhyāṁ tu yat syād anyan mahattaram
hetuyuktam ataḥ sarvaṁ jagat saṁparivartate
brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaiḥ śrāvyo rājanyaḥ kṣatriyais tathā
samyag ācara śuddhātmaṁs tataḥ siddhim avāpsyasi
durlabhā vedavidvāṁso vedokteṣu vyavasthitāḥ
sarva ete mahātmāno gacchanti paramāṁ gatim
manasas tu pralīnatvāt tat tad āhur nidarśanam
tasmāt tarṣātmakād rāgād bījāj jāyanti jantavaḥ
tribījam indradaivatyaṁ tasmād indriyam ucyate
saṁmohakaṁ tamo vidyāt kr̥ṣṇam ajñānasaṁbhavam
dīpād anye yathā dīpāḥ pravartante sahasraśaḥ
hiṁsāvihārābhiratas tandrīnidrāsamanvitaḥ
tasmāt samyak parīkṣeta doṣān ajñānasaṁbhavān
prītiduḥkhanibaddhāṁś ca samastāṁs trīn atho guṇān
sukhaduḥkhasamārambhāj janmājanmakr̥takṣaṇāḥ
janmato garbhavāsaṁ tu śukraśoṇitasaṁbhavam
dvijāgryo jāyate vidvān kanyasīṁ vr̥ttim āsthitaḥ
vedavid veda bhagavān vedāṅgāni br̥haspatiḥ
yat kr̥taṁ prāk śubhaṁ karma pāpaṁ vā tad upāśnute
dehakarma nudan prāṇān antakāle vimucyate
viṣādaśokāv aratir mānadarpāv anāryatā
rajastamoghnaṁ yat karma tapasas tat svalakṣaṇam
vimr̥śed ātmasaṁsthānām ekaikam anusaṁtatam
śabdaḥ sparśo ’tha rūpaṁ ca raso gandhas tathaiva ca
tatas tam upavartante guṇā rājasatāmasāḥ
vināśayati saṁbhūtam ayasmayamayo yathā
śrotraṁ śabdaguṇaṁ caiva cakṣur agner guṇas tathā
pravr̥ttilakṣaṇaṁ dharmaṁ prajāpatir athābravīt
yo yathāvad vijānāti sa vitr̥ṣṇo vimucyate
pramoho harṣajaḥ prītir asaṁdeho dhr̥tiḥ smr̥tiḥ
jyotiṣmad virajo divyam atra siddhaṁ mahātmanām
jñānayuktena manasā saṁtatena vicakṣaṇaḥ
brahma tatparamaṁ vedyam amr̥taṁ jyotir akṣaram
tathaitad antaraṁ vidyāt kṣetrakṣetrajñayor budhaḥ
ajaraḥ so ’maraś caiva vyaktāvyaktopadeśavān
tathaivātmā śarīrastho yogenaivātra dr̥śyate
madhu tailaṁ payaḥ sarpir māṁsāni lavaṇaṁ guḍaḥ
tad bījaṁ dehinām āhus tad bījaṁ jīvasaṁjñitam
payasy antarhitaṁ sarpir yadvan nirmathyate khajaiḥ
śrotraṁ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇaṁ pañcendriyāṇy api
vivakṣatā vā sadvākyaṁ dharmaṁ sūkṣmam avekṣatā
avyaktanidhanaṁ vidyād avyaktātmātmakaṁ manaḥ
indriyāṇāṁ śramāt svapnam āhuḥ sarvagataṁ budhāḥ
sarveṣām eva bhūtānāṁ puruṣaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate
te yānti paramām̐l lokān viśudhyanto yathābalam
tapo hy adhiṣṭhitaṁ devais tapoghnam asurais tamaḥ
anādyaṁ yat paraṁ brahma na devā narṣayo viduḥ
svapnayoge yathaivātmā pañcendriyasamāgataḥ
ā dehād apramādāc ca dehāntād vipramucyate
sattvasthaḥ sāttvikān bhāvāñ śuddhān paśyati saṁśritaḥ
manasy antarhitaṁ dvāraṁ deham āsthāya mānasam
sa tayor apavargajño vītarāgo vimucyate
karmaṇā vyāpyate pūrvaṁ karmaṇā copapadyate
jñānādhiṣṭhānam ajñānaṁ buddhyahaṁkāralakṣaṇam
vayotīto jarāmr̥tyū jitvā brahma sanātanam
tad evam etau vijñeyāv avyaktapuruṣāv ubhau
kam abhiṣṭuvate cāyaṁ kaṁ vā krośati kiṁ vadet
rajastamobhavair bhāvais tad apy āhur duranvayam
bhārgavo nītiśāstraṁ ca jagāda jagato hitam
mano buddhyā nigr̥hṇīyād viṣayān manasātmanaḥ
evaṁ yuktena manasā jñānaṁ tad upapadyate
sparśarūparasādyeṣu saṅgaṁ gacchanti bāliśāḥ
atha vā manasaḥ saṅgaṁ paśyed bhūtānukampayā
tataḥ paśyaty asaṁbaddhān vātapittakaphottarān
iyaṁ sā buddhir anyeyaṁ yayā yāti parāṁ gatim
atrocyate yathā hy etad veda yogeśvaro hariḥ
so ’tra vedayate vedyaṁ sa śr̥ṇoti sa paśyati
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṁ tad adhyātmaguṇaṁ viduḥ
sthānebhyo dhvaṁsamānāś ca sūkṣmatvāt tān upāsate
cakravat parivartante hy ajñānāj jantavo bhr̥śam
tadvad bhūteṣv ahaṁkāraṁ vidyād bhūtapravartakam
svapne ’py evaṁ yathābhyeti manaḥsaṁkalpajaṁ rajaḥ
atropāyaṁ pravakṣyāmi yathāvac chāstracakṣuṣā
tasmāt tanmātram ādadyād yāvad atra prayojanam
yat tat sadasad avyaktaṁ svapity asmin nidarśanam
sa duḥkhaṁ prāpya loke ’smin narakāyopapadyate
dr̥śyante tāni tāny eva tathā brahmāharātriṣu
saṁtanvānā yathā yānti tathā dehāḥ śarīriṇām
saṁsārāṇām asaṁkhyānāṁ kāmātmā tad avāpnuyāt

mAtRpitRsahasrANi putradArazatAni ca
vaidyAz cApy AturAH santi balavantaH sudurbalAH
so 'yaM vipulam adhvAnaM kAlena dhruvam adhruvaH
naro 'vazaH samabhyeti sarvabhUtaniSevitam
na kaz cij jAtv atikrAmej jarAmRtyU ha mAnavaH
ye ca viMzativarSA vA triMzadvarSAz ca mAnavAH
striyo 'kSA mRgayA pAnaM prasaGgAn ninditA budhaiH
yajec ca vidvAn vidhivat trivargaM cApy anuvrajet
balinAM durbalAnAM ca hrasvAnAM mahatAm api
ye cAnAthAH parAnnAdAH kAlas teSu samakriyaH
rasAyanavidaz caiva suprayuktarasAyanAH
sarvaprANabhRtAM vRttaM prekSamANas tatas tataH
yad yad iSTam asaMtoSAd durAtmA pApam Acaran
nauSadhAni na zAstrANi na homA na punar japAH
parikSINaH parasvAnAm AdAnaM sAdhu manyate
niyataM sarvabhUtAnAM kAlenaiva bhavanty uta
zItam uSNaM tathA varSaM kAlena parivartate
mAnasAnAM punar yonir duHkhAnAM cittavibhramaH
bahUnAm icchatAM nAsti samRddhAnAM viceSTatAm
yathA kASThaM ca kASThaM ca sameyAtAM mahodadhau
tathaiva tapasopetAH svAdhyAyAbhyasane ratAH
dRzyate nAbhyatikrAmann atikrAnto na vA punaH
ye cApi puruSaiH strIbhir gItavAdyair upasthitAH
naivAsya kaz cid bhavitA nAyaM bhavati kasya cit
vAyum AkAzam agniM ca candrAdityAv ahaHkSape
dRzyante cApi bahavaH saMprasaktA bahuzrutAH
jyotIMSi saritaH zailAn kaH karoti bibharti vA
gandhavarNarasasparzA nivartante svabhAvataH
prAdurbhAvaz ca bhUtAnAM dehanyAsas tathaiva ca
sa prasiktamanA bhogAn visRjya pitRsaMcitAn
avarjanIyAs te 'rthA vai kAGkSitAz ca tato 'nyathA
saMsAreSv anubhUtAni kasya te kasya vA vayam
AsanaM zayanaM yAnam utthAnaM pAnabhojanam

evam eva manuSyANAM sukhaduHkhe nararSabha
arthAnarthau sukhaM duHkhaM vidhAnam anuvartate

pareNa te varSazatAn na bhaviSyanti pArthiva
prAptivyAyAmayogaz ca sarvam etat pratiSThitam
jarAmRtyU ha bhUtAni khAditArau vRkAv iva
daridraz ca parikliSTaH zatavarSo janAdhipa

jAtAnAM sarvabhUtAnAM na pakSA na punaH kSapAH

text.ud:
मातृपितृसहस्राणि पुत्रदारशतानि च
वैद्याश्चाप्यातुराः सन्ति बलवन्तः सुदुर्बलाः
सोऽयं विपुलमध्वानं कालेन ध्रुवमध्रुवः
नरोऽवशः समभ्येति सर्वभूतनिषेवितम्
न कश्चिज्जात्वतिक्रामेज्जरामृत्यू ह मानवः
ये च विंशतिवर्षा वा त्रिंशद्वर्षाश्च मानवाः
स्त्रियोऽक्षा मृगया पानं प्रसङ्गान्निन्दिता बुधैः
यजेच्च विद्वान्विधिवत्त्रिवर्गं चाप्यनुव्रजेत्
बलिनां दुर्बलानां च ह्रस्वानां महतामपि
ये चानाथाः परान्नादाः कालस्तेषु समक्रियः
रसायनविदश्चैव सुप्रयुक्तरसायनाः
सर्वप्राणभृतां वृत्तं प्रेक्षमाणस्ततस्ततः
यद्यदिष्टमसंतोषाद्दुरात्मा पापमाचरन्
नौषधानि न शास्त्राणि न होमा न पुनर्जपाः
परिक्षीणः परस्वानामादानं साधु मन्यते
नियतं सर्वभूतानां कालेनैव भवन्त्युत
शीतमुष्णं तथा वर्षं कालेन परिवर्तते
मानसानां पुनर्योनिर्दुःखानां चित्तविभ्रमः
बहूनामिच्छतां नास्ति समृद्धानां विचेष्टताम्
यथा काष्ठं च काष्ठं च समेयातां महोदधौ
तथैव तपसोपेताः स्वाध्यायाभ्यसने रताः
दृश्यते नाभ्यतिक्रामन्नतिक्रान्तो न वा पुनः
ये चापि पुरुषैः स्त्रीभिर्गीतवाद्यैरुपस्थिताः
नैवास्य कश्चिद्भविता नायं भवति कस्यचित्
वायुमाकाशमग्निं च चन्द्रादित्यावहःक्षपे
दृश्यन्ते चापि बहवः संप्रसक्ता बहुश्रुताः
ज्योतींषि सरितः शैलान्कः करोति बिभर्ति वा
गन्धवर्णरसस्पर्शा निवर्तन्ते स्वभावतः
प्रादुर्भावश्च भूतानां देहन्यासस्तथैव च
स प्रसिक्तमना भोगान्विसृज्य पितृसंचितान्
अवर्जनीयास्तेऽर्था वै काङ्क्षिताश्च ततोऽन्यथा
संसारेष्वनुभूतानि कस्य ते कस्य वा वयम्
आसनं शयनं यानमुत्थानं पानभोजनम्
न त्वं पश्यसि तानद्य न त्वां पश्यन्ति तेऽपि च
एवमेव मनुष्याणां सुखदुःखे नरर्षभ
अर्थानर्थौ सुखं दुःखं विधानमनुवर्तते
दृश्यन्ते बहवो वैद्या व्याधिभिः समभिप्लुताः
परेण ते वर्षशतान्न भविष्यन्ति पार्थिव
प्राप्तिव्यायामयोगश्च सर्वमेतत्प्रतिष्ठितम्
जरामृत्यू ह भूतानि खादितारौ वृकाविव
दरिद्रश्च परिक्लिष्टः शतवर्षो जनाधिप
आराधयन्स्वर्गमिमं च लोकं; परं च मुक्त्वा हृदयव्यलीकम्
सुप्रियैर्विप्रयोगश्च संप्रयोगस्तथाप्रियैः
संनिमज्जज्जगदिदं गम्भीरे कालसागरे
अपि सागरपर्यन्तां विजित्येमां वसुंधराम्
जातानां सर्वभूतानां न पक्षा न पुनः क्षपाः
तेषां परमदुःखानां बुद्ध्या भेषजमादिशेत्
कस्मात्कमनुशोचेयमित्येवं स्थापयेन्मनः
तत्तद्धि चेतनामस्य हरत्यभ्रमिवानिलः
तानि तान्यभिवर्तन्ते दुःखानि च सुखानि च
अहमेतत्करोमीति मन्यते कालचोदितः
कुले जन्म तथा वीर्यमारोग्यं धैर्यमेव च
नायमत्यन्तसंवासो लभ्यते जातु केनचित्
कुर्वीत पितृदैवत्यं धर्माणि च समाचरेत्
काष्ठान्यपि हि जीर्यन्ते दरिद्राणां नराधिप
न ह्यहानि निवर्तन्ते न मासा न पुनः समाः
दातारो यज्ञशीलाश्च न तरन्ति जरान्तकौ

इत्येवं हेतुभिस्तस्य त्रिभिश्चित्तं प्रसिच्यति

पितृदेवमहर्षीणामानृण्यायानसूयकः

पथि संगतमेवेदं दारबन्धुसुहृद्गणैः

न ह्येव पुरुषो द्रष्टा स्वर्गस्य नरकस्य वा
बहूनामिच्छतां नास्ति समृद्धानां विचेष्टताम्
यथा काष्ठं च काष्ठं च समेयातां महोदधौ
प्राप्तिव्यायामयोगश्च सर्वमेतत्प्रतिष्ठितम्
तत्तद्धि चेतनामस्य हरत्यभ्रमिवानिलः
नियतं सर्वभूतानां कालेनैव भवन्त्युत
एवमेव मनुष्याणां सुखदुःखे नरर्षभ
न कश्चिज्जात्वतिक्रामेज्जरामृत्यू ह मानवः
न ह्यहानि निवर्तन्ते न मासा न पुनः समाः
सर्वप्राणभृतां वृत्तं प्रेक्षमाणस्ततस्ततः
त्रायन्ते मृत्युनोपेतं जरया वापि मानवम्
नौषधानि न शास्त्राणि न होमा न पुनर्जपाः
कुर्वीत पितृदैवत्यं धर्माणि च समाचरेत्
आसनं शयनं यानमुत्थानं पानभोजनम्
स प्रसिक्तमना भोगान्विसृज्य पितृसंचितान्
दृश्यन्ते जरया भग्ना नगा नागैरिवोत्तमैः
निर्याणं यस्य यद्दिष्टं तेन गच्छति हेतुना
प्रादुर्भावश्च भूतानां देहन्यासस्तथैव च
मानसानां पुनर्योनिर्दुःखानां चित्तविभ्रमः
इति कालेन सर्वार्थानीप्सितानीप्सितानि च
पूर्वे वयसि मध्ये वाप्युत्तमे वा नराधिप
सुप्रियैर्विप्रयोगश्च संप्रयोगस्तथाप्रियैः
तानि तान्यभिवर्तन्ते दुःखानि च सुखानि च
न त्वं पश्यसि तानद्य न त्वां पश्यन्ति तेऽपि च
अहमेतत्करोमीति मन्यते कालचोदितः
दरिद्रश्च परिक्लिष्टः शतवर्षो जनाधिप
चरितब्रह्मचर्यो हि प्रजायेत यजेत च
ये चानाथाः परान्नादाः कालस्तेषु समक्रियः
इति कालेन सर्वार्थानीप्सितानीप्सितानि च
अपि सागरपर्यन्तां विजित्येमां वसुंधराम्
नैवास्य कश्चिद्भविता नायं भवति कस्यचित्
बहूनामिच्छतां नास्ति समृद्धानां विचेष्टताम्
इत्येवं हेतुभिस्तस्य त्रिभिश्चित्तं प्रसिच्यति
यजेच्च विद्वान्विधिवत्त्रिवर्गं चाप्यनुव्रजेत्
एवमेव मनुष्याणां सुखदुःखे नरर्षभ
निर्याणं यस्य यद्दिष्टं तेन गच्छति हेतुना
मानसानां पुनर्योनिर्दुःखानां चित्तविभ्रमः
एवमेतानि दुःखानि तानि तानीह मानवम्
सौभाग्यमुपभोगश्च भवितव्येन लभ्यते
रज्ज्वा च मरणं जन्तोरुच्चाच्च पतनं तथा
अर्थानर्थौ सुखं दुःखं विधानमनुवर्तते
दृश्यन्ते बहवो वैद्या व्याधिभिः समभिप्लुताः
दृश्यन्ते जरया भग्ना नगा नागैरिवोत्तमैः
कुले जन्म तथा वीर्यमारोग्यं धैर्यमेव च
ये च विंशतिवर्षा वा त्रिंशद्वर्षाश्च मानवाः
ज्योतींषि सरितः शैलान्कः करोति बिभर्ति वा
नौषधानि न शास्त्राणि न होमा न पुनर्जपाः
दातारो यज्ञशीलाश्च न तरन्ति जरान्तकौ
क्व नु तेऽद्य पिता राजन्क्व नु तेऽद्य पितामहः
अपि स्वेन शरीरेण किमुतान्येन केनचित्
कस्मात्कमनुशोचेयमित्येवं स्थापयेन्मनः
अभिजातोऽस्मि सिद्धोऽस्मि नास्मि केवलमानुषः
तानि तान्यभिवर्तन्ते दुःखानि च सुखानि च
विविधान्युपवर्तन्ते तथा सांस्पर्शकानि च
पितृदेवमहर्षीणामानृण्यायानसूयकः
प्रादुर्भावश्च भूतानां देहन्यासस्तथैव च
तेषामन्यतरापत्तौ यद्यदेवोपसेवते
नियतं सर्वभूतानां कालेनैव भवन्त्युत
सन्ति पुत्राः सुबहवो दरिद्राणामनिच्छताम्
तमतिक्रान्तमर्यादमाददानमसांप्रतम्
सोऽयं विपुलमध्वानं कालेन ध्रुवमध्रुवः
स्त्रीमन्तश्च तथा षण्ढा विचित्रः कालपर्ययः
पथि संगतमेवेदं दारबन्धुसुहृद्गणैः
न कश्चिज्जात्वतिक्रामेज्जरामृत्यू ह मानवः
दरिद्रश्च परिक्लिष्टः शतवर्षो जनाधिप
शीतमुष्णं तथा वर्षं कालेन परिवर्तते
तथैव तपसोपेताः स्वाध्यायाभ्यसने रताः
न ह्येव पुरुषो द्रष्टा स्वर्गस्य नरकस्य वा
मातृपितृसहस्राणि पुत्रदारशतानि च
आयुर्वेदमधीयानाः केवलं सपरिग्रहम्
ते पिबन्तः कषायांश्च सर्पींषि विविधानि च
स यज्ञशीलः प्रजने निविष्टः; प्राग्ब्रह्मचारी प्रविभक्तपक्षः
स्त्रियोऽक्षा मृगया पानं प्रसङ्गान्निन्दिता बुधैः
गन्धवर्णरसस्पर्शा निवर्तन्ते स्वभावतः
त्रायन्ते मृत्युनोपेतं जरया वापि मानवम्
कुर्वीत पितृदैवत्यं धर्माणि च समाचरेत्
जातानां सर्वभूतानां न पक्षा न पुनः क्षपाः
प्राप्तिव्यायामयोगश्च सर्वमेतत्प्रतिष्ठितम्
स्पृशन्ति सर्वभूतानि निमित्तं नोपलभ्यते
दृश्यते हि युवैवेह विनश्यन्वसुमान्नरः
वैद्याश्चाप्यातुराः सन्ति बलवन्तः सुदुर्बलाः
सम्यग्घि धर्मं चरतो नृपस्य; द्रव्याणि चाप्याहरतो यथावत्
दृश्यन्ते चापि बहवः संप्रसक्ता बहुश्रुताः
नायमत्यन्तसंवासो लभ्यते जातु केनचित्
न त्वं पश्यसि तानद्य न त्वां पश्यन्ति तेऽपि च
संसारेष्वनुभूतानि कस्य ते कस्य वा वयम्
नरोऽवशः समभ्येति सर्वभूतनिषेवितम्
समेत्य च व्यतीयातां तद्वद्भूतसमागमः
संनिमज्जज्जगदिदं गम्भीरे कालसागरे
दृश्यते नाभ्यतिक्रामन्नतिक्रान्तो न वा पुनः
अकिंचनाश्च दृश्यन्ते पुरुषाश्चिरजीविनः
तत्तद्धि चेतनामस्य हरत्यभ्रमिवानिलः
सुप्रियैर्विप्रयोगश्च संप्रयोगस्तथाप्रियैः
अनित्ये प्रियसंवासे संसारे चक्रवद्गतौ
यद्यदिष्टमसंतोषाद्दुरात्मा पापमाचरन्
प्राप्तव्यमवशैः सर्वं परिहारो न विद्यते
तेषां परमदुःखानां बुद्ध्या भेषजमादिशेत्
प्रतिषेधन्ति राजानो लुब्धा मृगमिवेषुभिः
पथि संगतमेवेदं दारैरन्यैश्च बन्धुभिः
वायुमाकाशमग्निं च चन्द्रादित्यावहःक्षपे
प्रवृत्तचक्रस्य यशोऽभिवर्धते; सर्वेषु लोकेषु चराचरेषु
अहमेतत्करोमीति मन्यते कालचोदितः
रसायनविदश्चैव सुप्रयुक्तरसायनाः
क्वासं क्वास्मि गमिष्यामि को न्वहं किमिहास्थितः
अवर्जनीयास्तेऽर्था वै काङ्क्षिताश्च ततोऽन्यथा
चरितब्रह्मचर्यो हि प्रजायेत यजेत च
देहो वा जीवतोऽभ्येति जीवो वाभ्येति देहतः
उत्पन्नमिममात्मानं नरस्यानन्तरं ततः
न मृत्युमतिवर्तन्ते वेलामिव महोदधिः
यथा काष्ठं च काष्ठं च समेयातां महोदधौ
ये चापि पुरुषैः स्त्रीभिर्गीतवाद्यैरुपस्थिताः
ये चानाथाः परान्नादाः कालस्तेषु समक्रियः
पूर्वे वयसि मध्ये वाप्युत्तमे वा नराधिप
जरामृत्युमहाग्राहे न कश्चिदवबुध्यते
बलिनां दुर्बलानां च ह्रस्वानां महतामपि
न दृष्टपूर्वं प्रत्यक्षं परलोकं विदुर्बुधाः
परेण ते वर्षशतान्न भविष्यन्ति पार्थिव
आगमांस्त्वनतिक्रम्य श्रद्धातव्यं बुभूषता
समृद्धे च कुले जाता विनश्यन्ति पतंगवत्
सर्वप्राणभृतां वृत्तं प्रेक्षमाणस्ततस्ततः
जरामृत्यू ह भूतानि खादितारौ वृकाविव
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं भूतानां पर्युपस्थितम्
प्रायेण श्रीमतां लोके भोक्तुं शक्तिर्न विद्यते
आसनं शयनं यानमुत्थानं पानभोजनम्
व्याधिरग्निर्जलं शस्त्रं बुभुक्षा श्वापदं विषम्
स प्रसिक्तमना भोगान्विसृज्य पितृसंचितान्
न ह्यहानि निवर्तन्ते न मासा न पुनः समाः
अनिष्टोपनिपातो वा तृतीयं नोपपद्यते
तथैव सुखदुःखानि विधानमनुवर्तते
काष्ठान्यपि हि जीर्यन्ते दरिद्राणां नराधिप
आराधयन्स्वर्गमिमं च लोकं; परं च मुक्त्वा हृदयव्यलीकम्
आगमस्तु सतां चक्षुर्नृपते तमिहाचर
परिक्षीणः परस्वानामादानं साधु मन्यते

mātr̥pitr̥sahasrāṇi putradāraśatāni ca
vaidyāś cāpy āturāḥ santi balavantaḥ sudurbalāḥ
so ’yaṁ vipulam adhvānaṁ kālena dhruvam adhruvaḥ
naro ’vaśaḥ samabhyeti sarvabhūtaniṣevitam
na kaś cij jātv atikrāmej jarāmr̥tyū ha mānavaḥ
ye ca viṁśativarṣā vā triṁśadvarṣāś ca mānavāḥ
striyo ’kṣā mr̥gayā pānaṁ prasaṅgān ninditā budhaiḥ
yajec ca vidvān vidhivat trivargaṁ cāpy anuvrajet
balināṁ durbalānāṁ ca hrasvānāṁ mahatām api
ye cānāthāḥ parānnādāḥ kālas teṣu samakriyaḥ
rasāyanavidaś caiva suprayuktarasāyanāḥ
sarvaprāṇabhr̥tāṁ vr̥ttaṁ prekṣamāṇas tatas tataḥ
yad yad iṣṭam asaṁtoṣād durātmā pāpam ācaran
nauṣadhāni na śāstrāṇi na homā na punar japāḥ
parikṣīṇaḥ parasvānām ādānaṁ sādhu manyate
niyataṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ kālenaiva bhavanty uta
śītam uṣṇaṁ tathā varṣaṁ kālena parivartate
mānasānāṁ punar yonir duḥkhānāṁ cittavibhramaḥ
bahūnām icchatāṁ nāsti samr̥ddhānāṁ viceṣṭatām
yathā kāṣṭhaṁ ca kāṣṭhaṁ ca sameyātāṁ mahodadhau
tathaiva tapasopetāḥ svādhyāyābhyasane ratāḥ
dr̥śyate nābhyatikrāmann atikrānto na vā punaḥ
ye cāpi puruṣaiḥ strībhir gītavādyair upasthitāḥ
naivāsya kaś cid bhavitā nāyaṁ bhavati kasya cit
vāyum ākāśam agniṁ ca candrādityāv ahaḥkṣape
dr̥śyante cāpi bahavaḥ saṁprasaktā bahuśrutāḥ
jyotīṁṣi saritaḥ śailān kaḥ karoti bibharti vā
gandhavarṇarasasparśā nivartante svabhāvataḥ
prādurbhāvaś ca bhūtānāṁ dehanyāsas tathaiva ca
sa prasiktamanā bhogān visr̥jya pitr̥saṁcitān
avarjanīyās te ’rthā vai kāṅkṣitāś ca tato ’nyathā
saṁsāreṣv anubhūtāni kasya te kasya vā vayam
āsanaṁ śayanaṁ yānam utthānaṁ pānabhojanam
na tvaṁ paśyasi tān adya na tvāṁ paśyanti te ’pi ca
evam eva manuṣyāṇāṁ sukhaduḥkhe nararṣabha
arthānarthau sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ vidhānam anuvartate
dr̥śyante bahavo vaidyā vyādhibhiḥ samabhiplutāḥ
pareṇa te varṣaśatān na bhaviṣyanti pārthiva
prāptivyāyāmayogaś ca sarvam etat pratiṣṭhitam
jarāmr̥tyū ha bhūtāni khāditārau vr̥kāv iva
daridraś ca parikliṣṭaḥ śatavarṣo janādhipa
ārādhayan svargam imaṁ ca lokaṁ; paraṁ ca muktvā hr̥dayavyalīkam
supriyair viprayogaś ca saṁprayogas tathāpriyaiḥ
saṁnimajjaj jagad idaṁ gambhīre kālasāgare
api sāgaraparyantāṁ vijityemāṁ vasuṁdharām
jātānāṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ na pakṣā na punaḥ kṣapāḥ
teṣāṁ paramaduḥkhānāṁ buddhyā bheṣajam ādiśet
kasmāt kam anuśoceyam ity evaṁ sthāpayen manaḥ
tat tad dhi cetanām asya haraty abhram ivānilaḥ
tāni tāny abhivartante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca
aham etat karomīti manyate kālacoditaḥ
kule janma tathā vīryam ārogyaṁ dhairyam eva ca
nāyam atyantasaṁvāso labhyate jātu kena cit
kurvīta pitr̥daivatyaṁ dharmāṇi ca samācaret
kāṣṭhāny api hi jīryante daridrāṇāṁ narādhipa
na hy ahāni nivartante na māsā na punaḥ samāḥ
dātāro yajñaśīlāś ca na taranti jarāntakau
jarāmr̥tyumahāgrāhe na kaś cid avabudhyate
kvāsaṁ kvāsmi gamiṣyāmi ko nv ahaṁ kim ihāsthitaḥ
sa yajñaśīlaḥ prajane niviṣṭaḥ; prāg brahmacārī pravibhaktapakṣaḥ
teṣām anyatarāpattau yad yad evopasevate
akiṁcanāś ca dr̥śyante puruṣāś cirajīvinaḥ
pathi saṁgatam evedaṁ dārabandhusuhr̥dgaṇaiḥ
samyag ghi dharmaṁ carato nr̥pasya; dravyāṇi cāpy āharato yathāvat
vyādhir agnir jalaṁ śastraṁ bubhukṣā śvāpadaṁ viṣam
āyurvedam adhīyānāḥ kevalaṁ saparigraham
niryāṇaṁ yasya yad diṣṭaṁ tena gacchati hetunā
spr̥śanti sarvabhūtāni nimittaṁ nopalabhyate
deho vā jīvato ’bhyeti jīvo vābhyeti dehataḥ
trāyante mr̥tyunopetaṁ jarayā vāpi mānavam
dr̥śyante jarayā bhagnā nagā nāgair ivottamaiḥ
rajjvā ca maraṇaṁ jantor uccācca patanaṁ tathā
āgamāṁs tv anatikramya śraddhātavyaṁ bubhūṣatā
vividhāny upavartante tathā sāṁsparśakāni ca
caritabrahmacaryo hi prajāyeta yajeta ca
